title: 32x32 Boo
description: To be used with this this sprite.

name: smwgraphics-32x32-cloud
title: 32x32 Cloud
description: This is a 32x32 Cloud block. Please give credit.

name: smwgraphics-32x32-sprites-pack
title: 32x32 Sprites Pack 3
description:
This is my third pack of 32x32 sprite graphics! Again, it's a bunch of sprites that have 2 walking frames, ready to reskin pretty much any 32x32 sprite out there. Autisticsceptile requested these as well, using them as graphics for the ultimate noob sprite. I'm gonna list them but you can just look at them below

- Elephant
- Wizard that looks like Wiz (Kirby and the Amazing Mirror)
- Little girl with temper issues (2 sprites, one normal the other angry)
- Alarm clock guy, similar to Mr. Tick Tock (Kirby as well)
- 2 mermaids (in separate files as they use different palettes)
- Anglerfish
- Weasel in the style of the Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad
- Legged palm tree sort of similar to Exeggcutor (Pokémon)
- Some emperor dude supposed to look like Clovis (Code Geass)
- Tatanga (Super Mario Land)
- Fishperson

name: smwgraphics-3d-bonus-blocks
title: 3D Bonus Blocks
description:
This is a tileset I worked really hard on. With this tileset, you can create "3D" looking blocks. Please give credit if you use this.

This tileset works best in a Layer 2 level with the interactive parts on layer 2 with priority off and the foreground on layer 1 with priority on. In the first screenshot and the sample level, the green parts are on Layer 1 and the yellow parts are on layer 2.

If I am missing something or have any more questions/doubts, please leave them in the comment section.

Doesn't use custom palettes; works with vanilla palettes 3, 5, 6 and 7.

name: smwgraphics-3d-pinball-express-terrormeister
title: 3D Pinball Express - Terrormeister
description:
A Background that appears in one of the Themes from 3D Pinball Express. It was edited and it's palette very optimized to fit in SMW. Althrough it's small, it uses almost all of the 3 slots of BG. Works well on Cemetery/Graveyards or Haunted places.
Happy Halloween!

name: smwgraphics-5-computers-in-love
title: 5 Computers in Love
description:
This font was used in almost all texts in FNaF 3. Use for cutscenes. No custom palette required.

NOTE: If you don't know why the 2 and the 5 aren't in the numbers, it's because they're the same as the Z and the S.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-beach
title: 8-Bit Beach
description: This is a sunny 8-bit beach set for your 8-bit style hacks.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-castle
title: 8-Bit Castle
description: Here's an 8-bit-style castle/fortress tileset, complete with lava and skewers.  Whether or not the princess is here is up to you.

title: 8-Bit Cave

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-factory
title: 8-Bit Factory
description: This 8-bit factory tileset is inspired by the 8-bit version of Scrap Brain Zone and features pistons that can be used with Layer 2 Smash, along with conveyor belts and electric currents that can be used with custom blocks.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-forest
title: 8-Bit Forest
description: Here's a very green 8-bit forest tileset to go with all the other ones I've recently submitted.  Sorry about the wrong Map16 file I submitted before.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-ghost-house
title: 8-Bit Ghost House
description: Next up in my 8-Bit Graphics Series is this spoopy Ghost House set!

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-giant-spiny
title: 8-bit Giant Spiny
description:
Custom, 8-bit-esque graphics for mikeyk's Giant Spiny sprite, originally drawn by SmithyGCN and converted to fit the sprite by me. It comes with the necessary palette.

Two .bins are included, which allows the sprite to be used with Banzai Bills or sideways Giant Piranha Plants. It has four colours, which was SmithyGCN's original decision, but recolour one of them or put it on a background that is one of the colours in the sprite if you really need it to look NES-like.

Anorakun's edit: Updated with a new gif.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-grassland
title: 8-Bit Grassland
description: This 8-bit grassland would be great for the first world of any traditional 8-bit hack.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-graveyard
title: 8-Bit Graveyard
description: Here's a spooky graveyard set inspired by Pumpkin Zone and Pumpkin Hill.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-ice
title: 8-Bit Ice
description: Let it snow!  Let it snow!  Let it RETRO with this 8-bit ice/snow tileset!

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-ice-cave
title: 8-Bit Ice Cave
description: Here's a chillier 8-bit cave set for your 8-bit ice worlds!

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-moon

description: Here's an out-of-this-world 8-bit tileset for your spacy/lunar levels.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-mountain
title: 8-Bit Mountain
description: This mountain tileset is the next in my 2018 8-Bit Graphic collection.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-parabeetle
title: 8-bit Parabeetle
description:
A custom parabeetle by SmithyGCN now in 16x16 form. The palette is for Palette C but it can be moved to any row since the various speeds of parabeetle use different palettes.

Anorakun's edit: Updated with a new gif.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-ruins
title: 8-Bit Ruins
description: Here's the 9th tileset in my C3 Summer 2018 8-Bit Graphics Collection.  It's a ruins/temple tileset with some jungle/forest elements.

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-sky
title: 8-Bit Sky
description: Here's a cloud/mushroom/athletic set to go with the other 8-bit sets I've released during Summer C3 2018.  This set does cheat a little by filling in parts of the foreground with a copy of the back area color.

title: 8-Bit Styled Giant Masked Koopa Boss

original sprite is giant masked koopa

Moderator note: Use with Giant Masked Koopa Boss

An 8-bit thwomp graphic drawn by me


credit isn't needed but appreciated

name: smwgraphics-8-bit-underwater
title: 8-Bit Underwater
description: Dive into the RETRO with this deep blue 8-bit ocean set.

name: smwgraphics-8x8-coins
title: 8x8 Coins
description:
8x8 coin graphic drawn from scratch. Included is a level file with Level ExAnimation set up, as well as Map16 and ExGFX (AN2) files. Most coins are set to act as 2C, so they will remain coins after a POW has been activated, but I also included a coin that acts as 2B, and will turn into a brown block.

Please give credit if used. Enjoy!

name: smwgraphics-a-very-special-mario-world-anti-aliased-font-old
title: A Very Special Mario World - Anti-Aliased Font (Old)
description:
The anti-aliased font used in early versions of A Very Special Mario World. Credit is appreciated but not necessary.

Removes the A and N from the unused AND text!

A foreground tileset used in the school levels from the Aaahh!!! Real Monsters game for the SNES. Credit isn't required if you use this, but it would be appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-abandoned-lab
title: Abandoned Lab
description: It's a fairly simple abandoned lab set complete with Fish-Stemmed Piranha Plants and Floating Munchers in stasis tubes.

name: smwgraphics-abstract-earthbound-mother
title: Abstract Earthbound/Mother 3 BG Collage
description: I decided I'd make an abstract background with EarthBound and Mother 3 graphics. It loops horizontally.

name: smwgraphics-acme-animation-factory-intro-screen-font
title: ACME Animation Factory - intro screen font
description:
The font used during the intro screen of 'ACME Animation Factory', a Mario Paint-Like SNES Game.
Letters have 3 colors in the original game, but they were arranged to use only 2 colors.

It includes a GFX2A file. I added new characters such as 8, 9, a double quote (replace an unused tile), and also 'ILLUSI' and 'YELLOW' if you use these. Yoshi's footprint is also changed to match.

versions.title: ACME Animation Factory - intro screen font

name: smwgraphics-actraiser
title: ActRaiser 2 - Lovaous Palace (Exterior)
description:
A very beautiful icy background from ActRaiser 2. A great fit for towns (the background has a town in far distance), ice and / or castle themed levels.

Includes two sample levels. One is the original game tilemap and has background scrolling to NONE, NONE. The other one is an improvised loop I did with the original background, removing part of the land part.

Updated to use the background HDMA. Special thanks to Donut, which coded the effect to be as close as possible to the original. Insert it with the UberASM tool.

Credit would be great, but is optional.

versions.title: ActRaiser 2 - Deception
versions.filename: ActRaiser 2 - Deception and Death Heim Rematch.zip

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-aitos-act
title: ActRaiser - Aitos (Act 2 ~ Boss Room)
description:
A cave background that contains creepy demon statues, from ActRaiser. Adapted for SMW usage.

A good fit for caves or boss battle arenas.

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-bloodpool-act
title: ActRaiser - Bloodpool (Act 1)
description:
The second action stage of Actraiser, a poisonous swamp.

Just like the original game, using parallax scrolling in this background is highly recommended.

UPDATE: Reripped from scratch. Much more accurate to the source material, at the cost of an extra palette row. It's now extremely optimized, having a lot of free space in BG2 now. Palette and map 16 are also better organized. Background loops properly now.

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-death-heim-boss-rush
title: ActRaiser - Death Heim (Boss Rush)
description:
One of Death Heim's backgrounds, seen while The Master is refighting the main bosses of the game.

Use it with parallaxing scrolling to make the best use of this background.

The eclipse uses the back area color, so it can be used with layer 3 behind the layer 2.

A good fit for mountain levels.

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-death-heim-final-boss
title: ActRaiser - Death Heim (Final Boss)
description:
One of the backgrounds seen during the final level of ActRaiser. The original game uses distortion effects to make it look even more amazing. Should be very easy to loop and adjust.

A good fit for space levels, in general.

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-death-heim-stage-cleared
title: ActRaiser - Death Heim (Stage Cleared)
description:
The background seen when you finally clear ActRaiser. Compared to the original game, I took some liberties and lmade it loop, so it can be better used in SMW. The water itself is perfect for parallax scrolling.

A good fit for beach / ocean levels, in general.

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-fillmore-act
title: ActRaiser - Fillmore (Act 1)
description:
Part of the forest seen in the first action stage of ActRaiser. The complete tilemap is quite a nightmare to assemble, so I had to adapt it to fit with SMW standards. It's a quite big background, surprisingly.

I added some extra map 16 tiles to help users to vary the background a tiny bit. Its height is easy to adjust and it can even fit vertically scroll enabled levels.

A good fit for forests. Even spooky ones, perhaps.

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-font
title: ActRaiser - Font
description:
The font used in ActRaiser.
In the original game, letters have 2 colors, but I also add a version with only one color (because '2 colors' version looks weird with original overworld palettes).

It includes two GFX2A files. I added new characters such as 8, 9, double quotes, which are not in the original gfx (they replace unused tiles), # (not in Act Raiser), and also 'ILLUSI', Yoshi's footprint and 'YELLOW' if needed.

Mod note: for best results, change these colors to make the level names look better.

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-kasandora-act
title: ActRaiser - Kasandora (Act 1)
description:
The backgrounds seen in the desertic of Kasandora, from ActRaiser.

There's two versions of the background, which are seen on different parts of the level in the original game. They should be easy to adjust vertically, as well.

The first half uses palette row 3, but only has desert dunes and clouds.

Meanwhile, the second half uses palette rows 0 and 3, but has desert dunes, a big abyss and clouds. More GFX space is used, though.

Pick the one you like more.

A good fit for deserts, in general.

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-marahna-act
title: ActRaiser - Marahna (Act 2 ~ Boss Room)
description:
The background seen in the Act 2 of Marahna, from ActRaiser. Adapted and looped for usage in SMW Hacks. It's very simple to adjust the position of each element. Can be looped vertically too, if needed.

Due to it heavily relying in the black color, I've made it use the back area color.

Good fit for temples or castles, in general.

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-northwall-acts-1
title: ActRaiser - Northwall (Acts 1 & 2)
description: Background used in the first and second acts of Northwall in ActRaiser. The clouds can be used with parallaxing scrolling,  much like how it's done in the original game.

name: smwgraphics-actraiser-sky-palace
title: ActRaiser - Sky Palace
description:
The sky background that's seen in the Sky Palace menu of the game. Due to how the background is laid out in-game, I did my best to reduce the cutoff a tiny bit, shouldn't be too hard of adjusting, though. Works very well with parallax scrolling.

A good fit for sky levels.

name: smwgraphics-actual-yoshi-coin
title: Actual Yoshi Coin
description:
A Yoshi/Dragon coin with an actual Yoshi head on it, drawn completely from scratch. (Originally made for the ill-fated SMWCP1.5.)

Just replace your GFX14 with this file, or copy the coin out of there.

name: smwgraphics-advanced-muncher-animation
title: Advanced Muncher Animation
description: A pretty big improvement over the original ones.

title: Adventure Island - Beach/Sky
description:
Ripped from Adventure Island (NES).

INCLUDES:
- 2 ExGFX files (BG and FG)
- Map16 Pages
- Sample Level
- Palette

PLEASE GIVE CREDIT IF USED!

name: smwgraphics-adventures-of-sonic-the-hedgehog-dr-robotnik
title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog - Dr. Robotnik
description:
A rip of a Dr. Robotnik Charging Chuck resprite from "NO Body's SMW Sprite Dump" on Mario Fan Games Galaxy. The original sprite sheet was unfinished, only have the SP13 Chuck sprites. This rip comes with sprites for all Chucks, as well as an ASM file that fixes a color palette error when charging. Both done by me.

Pingus

Anorakun's note: Added a hex edit to fix the Diggin' Chuck's shoulder.

versions.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog - Dr. Robotnik

title: Adventurous Boy (Bootleg) - Stage 1
description:
Here's a background from a bootleg game I haven't heard of. It was released at Summer C3 2023. BG was possible to convert to layer 3 with little battle. Use the Remove Status Bar or any other status bar patch you like .
Have fun!

name: smwgraphics-aerial-assault-sega-master-system-sunset
title: Aerial Assault (Sega Master System) - Sunset
description: A sunset background from Aerial Assault for the Sega Master System. Comes with all sunset phase palettes. Also works well with some parallax.

name: smwgraphics-aero-blasters-turbografx
title: Aero Blasters (TurboGrafx-16) - Second Stage (Boss)
description:
A simple tiled background from the second stage boss from Aero Blasters (also known as Air Buster) for the TurboGrafx-16/PC Engine.

Relies on back area color being black.

name: smwgraphics-aero-the-acro-bat
title: Aero the Acro-Bat 2 (SNES) - Ektors Engine
description: Background used in Ektors Engine (AKA the Final Stage) in Aero the Acro-Bat 2 (SNES Version).

title: Aero the Acro-Bat 2 - Level 2

Re-ripped with smwedit's tool.

View full BG

name: smwgraphics-aerobiz-supersonic-intro
title: Aerobiz Supersonic - Intro
description:
Background from the intro to the SNES version of Aerobiz Supersonic. Works best with V-Scroll set to none.

Credit would be nice, but it isn't needed.

name: smwgraphics-airship
title: Airship
description: Here's an SMB3-style Airship set that includes cannons, Airship pipes, nuts, screws, flamethrowers, and animated propellers.

name: smwgraphics-airship-doomship
title: Airship/Doomship
description:
A custom Airship/Doomship tileset I made.

Includes:

- 2 different Palettes (Standard Airships, and one similar to the redish ones in SMB3.) in both .pal and .palmask formats.
- 2 different levels (One for outside, if you use the default Sky BG, and one for the interior.)
- 4 ExGFX Files (Specified below)
- 2 Map16 Pages (One for the FG, one for BG.)

The Flames act like 25 and should be used with a hurt block that acts as 25, though you can make them act like 12F if you want.


See the Readme for other notes.

name: smwgraphics-airship-of-the-future
title: Airship of the Future
description: A kinda futuristic airship I made by request a long time ago.

name: smwgraphics-akazukin-chacha-snes-save-selection
title: Akazukin Chacha (SNES) - Save Selection
description:
A layer 3 version of CHA CHA!

Requires a patch that changes status bar if you want to see the full image.

title: Aladdin (Genesis) - Agrabah Market

title: Alcahest - Chapter 6
description: Background used in the first chapter (map) in Alcahest (Super Famicom).

title: Alex Kidd in Miracle World - Mt. Eternal
description:
Ripped from the Mt. Eternal in Alex Kidd in Miracle World on Master System.

Note: Meant to be used with a Layer 2 level.

versions.title: Alex Kidd in Miracle World - Mt. Eternal
versions.filename: Alex Kidd in Miracle World - Mt. Eternal.zip

name: smwgraphics-alien-beetle
title: Alien Beetle
description:
Got Moley in your phone and got inspired by his silly space adventures? Worry not, this buzzy beetle replacement will fulfill all your needs for your space adventures in this wide galaxy. This reskin is clearly inspired by Super Metroid.

Credit should go to No Body The Dragon.

name: smwgraphics-alien-pokey
title: Alien Pokey
description:
A weird and bizarre alien creature, meant as a pokey reskin. Now available for your SMW romhacks.

A perfect fit for unknown or hostile planet environments.

Credit should go to No Body the Dragon (NBTD).

name: smwgraphics-alien-soldier-stage
title: Alien Soldier - Stage 1
description: Ripped from the first stage in Alien Soldier on Megadrive.

name: smwgraphics-alienators-evolution-continues-gba-stage
title: Alienators: Evolution Continues (GBA) - Stage 1
description:
Here's a BG from Stage 1 of Alienators: Evolution Continues for the Game Boy Advance. Most tiltles I've never heard of Ripped the BG with Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting feature, as saving new BG tilemaps in Racing Stripe Advance didn't do me good. The Save as Picture option did. I had to add 4 other 8x8 tiles and 5 Map16 tiles to make this BG loop. I used 1 8x8 tile for the the new back area color for the fake gradient.
Have fun!

name: smwgraphics-alpha-test-area
title: Alpha Test Area
description:
This tileset has many vibrant colors for their respective objects, also containing items from other Mario games, such as Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels, Super Mario Bros. 3, Super Mario Maker, etc.

It also contains 2 Background variants plus the default one, resulting in three options.

You can also use these blocks for the directional spikes, and the Screen Scrolling Pipes for the pipes, but they are optional.

Ripped from this sheet, made by SuperSledgeBro.

Enjoy!

name: smwgraphics-alternate-mario-world
title: Alternate Mario World
description:
ibz10g's original description: "This is a base hack. I've modified the graphics of Super Mario World in such a manner that I feel captures the game's original feeling, yet at the same time gives you a sense of renewal. You may use this as a base hack, and credit will not be required. Please feel free to pick and choose from these graphics. I've got a little correction for anyone who reads this."

With this said, have fun and give credits to the original author.

name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-mushroom-fire-flower-p-switch-and-poison-mushroom
title: Alternate Redrawn Mushroom, Fire Flower, P-Switch and Poison Mushroom
description:
Alternate Redrawn graphics meant for the Mushroom, Fire Flower, Blue and Silver P-Switches, and Thomas & Imamelia's Poison Mushroom Custom Sprite, based on their most modern designs.

Both the P-Switches and Poison Mushrooms come in 2 variations; the switches' bases can be either red-ish or blue/silver, while the Poison Mushroom can have a normal cap or one with a skull design.

Credit's not required, but heavily appreciated.

versions.title: Alternate Redrawn Mushroom, Fire Flower, P-Switch and Poison Mushroom

name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-styled-boo-pack
title: Alternate Redrawn Styled Boo Pack
description:
Alternate redrawn-style graphics for the Boo family of enemies found in Super Mario World - including the Green Gas Bubble by proxy of shared graphics - meant to make them look closer to their design from Super Mario Bros. Wonder.

The pack also includes graphics for all custom Boo enemies present on the site which require different graphics, such as:

* smkdan's YI Big Boo.
* imamelia's 32x32 Boo Block sprite.
* RussianMan's Small Boo Boss, and Sleepy Boo.
* JamesD28, Jammerjab, and imamelia's Stunnable Boo.
* Arinsu's Static Fishin' Boo.
* And Romi & ShadowMistressYuko's SMB3 Stretch.

Additionally, the pack includes simple foreground graphics for the white objects meant to be used with the SMB3 Stretch, alternative graphics for GFX 11 and the Small Boo Boss' file that depicts normal active Boos like the Mad Boos from Super Princess Peach, and a patch that contains a new palette for the boss versions of the Big Boo and Small Boo bosses.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-styled-bowser-and-koopa-clown-car-rooftop-arena
title: Alternate Redrawn Styled Bowser and Koopa Clown Car + Rooftop Arena
description:
Alternate redrawn-style graphics for Super Mario World Bowser's Koopa Clown Car, meant to resemble the enemy's modern cup-like design, as well for the rooftop arena Bowser's fought in

Due to the boss' palette being hardcoded within the game's code, a patch's been included that changes it to its intended colors (the .pal & .palmask files present only affect Bowser during the game's original credits).

Credit's not necessary.

versions.title: Alternate Redrawn Styled Bowser and Koopa Clown Car + Rooftop Arena
versions.filename: Alternate Redrawn Koopa Clown Car + Rooftop.zip

name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-styled-dino-rhino-dino-torch
title: Alternate Redrawn Styled Dino Rhino & Dino Torch
description:
Alternative Redrawn-styled graphics for SMW Dino Rhino and Dino Torch, meant to closely resemble their official artwork and their latest modern appearances in Paper Mario: Color Splash and Paper Mario: The Origami King, all while having them walk like in vanilla Super Mario World.

Credit's not necessary, but heavily appreciated regardless.

versions.title: Alternate Redrawn Styled Dino Rhino & Dino Torch
versions.filename: Alternate Redrawn Dino Rhino %26 Torch (all palettes).zip

name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-styled-mechakoopa-pack
title: Alternate Redrawn Styled Mechakoopa Pack
description:
Alternate redrawn-style graphics for Super Mario World's Mechakoopa, meant to resemble the enemy's modern design from NSMBWii onwards.

The pack also includes graphics for Eminus & Von Fahrenheit's Mechakoopa but Awesome custom sprite, as well for MellyMellouange's MechIggy custom sprite.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-styled-piranha-plant-pack
title: Alternate Redrawn Styled Piranha Plant Pack
description:
Alternate redrawn-style graphics meant for many variations of the well known Piranha Plant enemy which sport a slightly tweaked head and a new stem design.

As a whole, this pack includes new graphics for:
* SMW Vanilla Piranha Plants (sans the propeller stem from the jumping ones).
* Imamelia's Custom Piranha Plant and Venus Fire Trap sprites.
* mikeyk & Davros' Giant Piranha Plant sprites.
* The Biob's Jumping Giant Piranha Plant sprite.
* Koopster's Fat Piranha Plant sprite.
* Dahnamics's Giant Piranha Boss sprite.

There are two different variations for the graphics: one where the Piranha Plants look like in newer games (as in, with red/green heads), and another in which their head is brown-ish and their lips is green/red, which meant to invoke their look from the Super Mario 64 - Mario Party 6 era of games. On a related note, the Venus Fire Trap have two extra variations: one in which their head is dark-brown like the Super Mario 3D Land/World; and another where they blow fire rather than... spew it by opening their mouths.

The palette included covers all the sprites covered in the pack. From those, only the Giant Piranha Boss uses palettes E and F while it's fire projectiles use palette A.

Credit's not required but hugely appreciated nonetheless.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-amazing-flyin-hammer-bro
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Amazing Flyin' Hammer Bro.

If the look on SMW Redrawn's Hammer Brother graphic was too much like the other typical hammer brothers on their land counterparts and you still want to maintain consistency with the Redrawn art style for your projects, you come to the right place.

I recently made an alternative to that, heavily based off of Super Princess Peach's take of the Amazing Flyin' Hammer Brother, because as it turns out, the weird way it's face is...is intentional by design.

Read the text file on the differences, as it contains various alternatives. Extract this to GFX13. Do give credit if used.

versions.title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Amazing Flyin' Hammer Bro.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-blue-shelless-koopa-bob-omb-bullet-bill-goomba-super-koopa
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Blue Shelless Koopa, Bob-Omb, Bullet Bill, Goomba & Super Koopa
description:
A small miscellaneous set of Redrawn-styled graphics for the Sliding Shelless Koopas, Shelless Blue Koopa & Super Koopa (all 3 drawn in a 3/4ths perspective like most sprites on this style), Goomba (based on some graphics I did for a request a long time ago), Bullet Bill and Bob-Omb (both with slighly tweaked shading).

Graphics featuring the Blue Shelless Koopa & Super Koopa have slight variations with and without angry eyes. On a related note, the cape tiles have also been tweaked a bit to ensure these will look ok with the new graphics.

Finally, do note that to make use of the Goomba's squished graphics and the Bob-Omb's stunned frame, some specific hex edits are needed to make them appear through gameplay (a small patch is included just in case, which you can apply with Asar).

Credit's not required but it would be appreciated nonetheless.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-bullet-bill
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Bullet Bill
description:
Originally used in Synthetic Caverns - my CLDC 2023 entry (in its base form), this Bullet Bill was drawn as an alternative to SMW Redrawn's default Bullet Bill graphic for the purposes of contrasting itself more readily from dark backgrounds and having a shape more closely resembling the original SMW Bullet Bill sprite.

Give credit to me for the base graphic, and Moltz for recently drawing diagonal frames on request.

Update: Added Ex-Animation frames for the Bullet Bills based on how the enemies animate in Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-cement-blocks
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Cement Blocks
description:
This is basically SMW's cement block but retextured into the style that fits in SMW Redrawn. It is for those that prefer the look of the original game's cement block but want it to be in the Redrawn style for your projects.

Insert this as GFX14 in the FG1 slot. Because this is something that is used globally in base SMW and is on page 01 of the 16x16 Tile Editor, a map16 file is not provided for this resource.

Give credit if used.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-chucks
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Chucks
description: Alternative graphics for Chucks that have a more 3/4ths perspective, this was inspired by the Modern Redrawn Mario released by SF - The Dark Warrior and by the 3/4ths perspective Koopalings made by Moltz, the graphics were made with the blue palette in mind, to change the sprite's palette I would recommend using Tweaker, I also included a patch to fix Diggin' Chuck's shoulder.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-goal-orb
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Goal Orb
description:
Made an alternative to SMW Redrawn's orb graphic in order to look more faithful to the OG SMW's. The OG SMW version looked like a magic crystal orb and I wanted to restore that texturing with my own attempt while in the vein of SMW Redrawn's art style.

Included is "orb scrapyard.bin" which is various alternative attempts I made if you prefer to use those instead. Make sure you paste it to your respective GFX05.bin file.

Give credit if used.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-koopalings
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Koopalings
description:
Alternative SMW Redrawn-styled Koopalings I always wanted to give them an appearance more similar to the artwork from Super Mario Bros 3 and Super Mario World and also fix some things like Larry not having a jaw, Lemmy and Wendy being larger than the others and Roy was also very strange in sideview graphic, this should fix all these problems.
This is also compatible with the Morton and Roy fireball patch since I took the time to redrawn those frames as well.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-ninjis
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Ninjis
description:
New Ninji graphics made as an alternative to the ones seen in SMW Redrawn for your Redrawn-styled project needs.

These are made to be closer to the way the Ninjis are depicted in the base Super Mario World, being darkly-clad ninja type baddies that should blend in dark environments (Think Back Door from SMW).

Comes in 3 palette variations, with two further ones based on posing. Read the text file "important information.txt" for further instructions.

Give credit if used.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-porcu-puffer
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Porcu-Puffer
description:
Alternative SMW Redrawn-styled Porcu-Puffers I made in April of this year but never got around to finishing it till now.

Reason for this resource's existence - I find it weirdly off-model icegoom's version of the Porcu-Puffer is from the base Redrawn Hack when it should be more on-model to the official art that exists. Certain spritework in Redrawn needlessly deviated from the official art for a resource that intended to give a generally consistently modern Mario look to an old game.

Read the text file to find out on the differences, as it contains a lot of various alternative versions, too many to show on the Screenshots. Extract this to GFX06 in your SP4 slot. Give credit if used.

One of the variants requires remapping the palette of the sprite using STEAR.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-smile-coin
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Smile Coin
description:
Super Mario World Redrawn fits, for the coin from coin game cloud, a coin with a Toad badge, unlike original SMW that fits a coin with a happy face badge.

This alternative for the coin graphic is more likely SMW, with a redrawn styled happy face instead of a Toad for your redrawn project.

If your ROM doesn't have SMWR applied, the palette may be useful, but if you already has SMWR applied the palette already is included.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-spike-top
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Spike Top
description:
Originally released in 2022's Winter C3 that I should've submitted to the Graphics section ages ago but I didn't. Now that is corrected. Anyways, it's basically a 3/4ths view of the Spike Top that was made to be more aligned with most other SMW Redrawn sprites.

Comes in 2 main versions, further subdivided in their respective folders. Read INFORMATION.txt for said specific differences.

Give credit to BigPotato and I if you want to use it in your SMW Redrawn-styled hacks.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-spiny
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Spiny
description:
A spiny BigPotato and I made for Omega Threat, as an alternative to icegoom's Spiny in order to be consistent with the general 3/4ths view most SMW Redrawn enemy sprite graphics are in.

Comes in two versions, the original 3/4ths Spiny graphic BigPotato made, and the revisions I made to its shading to more closely resemble icegoom's Spiny graphic. Whichever version you prefer is there.

Extract to GFX02.

Give credit to me and BigPotato if used.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-sumo-bro
title: Alternative Redrawn Sumo Bro.
description:
Alternative graphic to icegoom's Sumo Brother to be more in line with how the original game's Sumo Brother looks like while in the Redrawn Style.

Comes in 4 variations. Was a part of a Winter C3 2024 release. Insert this in as GFX09, in the SP4 slot. Read the "important information.txt" for more details.

Give credit if used.

name: smwgraphics-amazing-flying-demoman

description: The Demoman is a self-described black Scottish cyclops and a scrumpy-swilling demolitions expert from Ullapool, Scotland, who is one of the most versatile members of the team. He also replaces the Flying Hammer Brother sprite.

Want to make a spooky scary level? Fret not, may the Grim Reaper aid you in this quest. This reskin of the AFHB (Amazing Flyin Hammer Bro) changes it to the deadly grim reaper. A great fit for your haunted levels. Also, it works well with the Stationary Hammer Bro sprite.

Credit should go to No Body The Dragon.

name: smwgraphics-amazing-flying-snowman
title: Amazing Flying Snowman
description: A neat replacement of the Amazing Flying Hammer Brother, perfect for ice / snow levels. Credits to No Body the Dragon. Uses vanilla palette. Can be used with the Stationary Hammer Bro sprite as well .

Link to trailer

If you intend to use the original SMW ending for your hack. Ensure that Peach uses a custom palette as unfortunately she is not compatible with these graphics.

If you encounter any problems with the graphics, feel free to let me know. Thanks for viewing!

- Sample level with assembled ExAnimation

No credit needed.

This is a rip from the game Ardy Lightfoot.

This rip contains an FG and 4 different Backgrounds.

It uses all palettes, but it doesn't overwrite the status bar and the first 9 palettes from row 6 (for the sake of coins and question blocks).

MWL's are included for each of the backgrounds, the tileset also has exanimation.

Credits would be nice since this took me a while, but they aren't necessary.

Lunar magic 1.70 or higher required.

name: smwgraphics-arkanoid-doh-it-again
title: Arkanoid: Doh It Again
description:
Submitted during Summer C3 2021!

Ever wanted to use a pretty-lookin' computer font for sci-fi themed hacks? Well, wait no longer. This is a rip of a font used in Arkanoid: Doh It Again. Includes both for message box dialogues and for pre-credits cutscene. So come brick it, (scout of) commander Therle!

name: smwgraphics-armey-and-porcupo

description:
An armadillo that replaces Buzzy Beetles and, and Porcupo that replaces Spinies.

Includes a second alternative version.

name: smwgraphics-armless-yoshi
title: Armless Yoshi
description:
Step right up and behold a true marvel of modern science and evolutionary choices! It's Yoshi, but he's got no arms! That's right, ladies and gents, NO ARMS!

Watch in amazement as he runs, jumps, and flutters using nothing but grit and pure leg power! How does he eat? That's the mystery, friends, that's the magic!

This incredible specimen uses the standard vanilla palette and replaces GFX33. Drop him into your game and give your players a sight they won't soon forget! Get your armless Yoshi today!

name: smwgraphics-arrows-and-item-indicators
title: Arrows and Item Indicators
description:
This is a pack of tiles intended to be used as item indicators. Essentially, they were made as a way to show where the player should throw/drop/use an item.
Think of it as in those kaizo levels where a coin is used to indicate where a shell should be thrown.
It also comes with arrow graphics in all 8 directions and "correct" and "wrong" symbols, so hopefully it can be useful in a variety of situations.

Note: This uses a handful of palette rows to accomodate for the palettes of all different sprites, but uses the right side of them, so the only palette that is overwritten is the Pink Berry's.
If you don't use all indicators, you might not need all the palettes. (The readme contains detailed information on palette usage)

This is a collection of the English alphabet fonts from the Neo Geo version of Art of Fighting. Its size is 8x16 and it contains Spanish and Portuguese orthography.

This font uses 8 colors mapped to the right-side palette on Row 5. It comes with two palette: the red font from the game's dialogue box ("Palette 1") and the blue font from its score board screen ("Palette 2"). README.txt contains their RGB values if you want to remap the palette to use both.

Yes, I have asked him to make the BG for my Make a Good Level 4 Contest entry and submit to the GFX section on Christmas. Now I'm submitting the necessary fixes in his stead.

name: smwgraphics-blues-brothers-electricity
title: Blues Brothers - Electricity
description:
The electric shocks from the Blues Brothers SNES game. Comes with both palettes (the file uses rows 2 and 3), a Map16 file, a YY-CHR graphics file, and a sample level with ExAnimation inserted. The tiles are currently treated as black piranha plant tiles, but you'll be able to make them into whatever you want, like maybe a custom block that instantly kills the player, just like the electricity from the Blues Brothers game.

The game itself is said to be bad and of course has nothing to do with the original 1980 R-rated movie, but in my opinion, the graphics look great. Hopefully, we can get some more graphic rips from this game in the future.

This didn't take much effort, so giving credit to me is an option, especially since I'm a skeptic and anticipate that you might not anyway.

-Goblin
-Ogre
-Pharaoh
-Spider
-Human Witch

If you want to use all 3 animations of each Boss, look into the ReadMe file, the instructions are under 'How to use'.

Disclaimer!

A credit to me & Iceguy would be appreciated. And also to autisticsceptile1993, without his request, these Characters would've never existed in the first place.

I have included 6 different palettes to use with these graphics. The Pink one is the default pink used in SMM.

name: smwgraphics-bumpy-cave
title: Bumpy Cave
description:
We all love a nice cave, so here's a nice cave tileset. Complete with extra lava so Mario can burn off his ass yet again! In all seriousness, it's got a couple of slopes and stuff, nothing major. You might find it useful, however.

Yep.

title: Bunny Reznor

name: smwgraphics-bush-and-rocks-field

name: smwgraphics-bushes-and-hills
title: Bushes and Hills
description: Here's a simple background set featuring patterned hills in 2 sizes and some foliage to go in front of them.  The foliage uses the last 3 colors of Palette Row 0, so you'll need a custom palette if you incorporate them into your setup or use the default provided in the .zip sample level.  If you're not using the bushes, the hills are compatible with vanilla background palettes, with the exception of 4.

name: smwgraphics-businessman-and-businesswoman
title: Businessman and Businesswoman
description:

Requested by autisticsceptile1993 and OrangeBronzeDaisy.

name: smwgraphics-bust-a-move-forest-stage

name: smwgraphics-butterfly
title: Butterfly

name: smwgraphics-cactus-lotus
title: Cactus Lotus
description:
A cactus lotus, which is just a Volcano Lotus adapted to desertic environments. Great for arid areas.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.

name: smwgraphics-cake
title: Cake
description:
I've been playing a lot of TSRP2 lately, and one of the levels in it inspired me to make this ExGFX. Included is cake, spikes, and a few decorations for spicing up a level. In my hack, I've had to credit a lot of people, and I know it's a pain in the neck, so I won't make you do it for this.

One last note: There's been a small glitch that I've been unable to fix in the Map16 data. A few objects that should behave like blank tiles behave like water, so if you want to use this, be sure to fix this yourself. Enjoy!

name: smwgraphics-cake-candy-tileset
title: Cake/Candy Tileset
description:
A sweet cake and candy tileset.

It uses a lot of palette rows, though only 2 and 3 are absolutely necessary if you're willing to cut down on candy colours.

Made for C3 2017 summer.

name: smwgraphics-cake-land
title: Cake Land
description:
Here you have another Food-Themed Foreground.
I made this for my HackRom but I wanted to share.
It can also be used as Snow.
Enjoy, and...

Credits are appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-cake-sweet
title: Cake/Sweet
description: I made this tileset a long time ago for an old hack I never finished, I hope you'll like it and find it usefull

name: smwgraphics-camping-site
title: Camping Site
description:
Tents and fire pit for decoration in camping themed levels. Comes with a sample level to copy the Ex animation. I made it for my hack.

Credits not required but I would appreciate it.

name: smwgraphics-candy-cane-platforms
title: Candy Cane Platforms
description: Semisolid candy cane platforms that can be used for levels with food or Christmas themes.

name: smwgraphics-candy-forest
title: Candy Forest
description: After watching Wreck-It Ralph several times, I finally got the inspiration to make a background to go with my Sweet Candy foreground.  It's a forest made of candy cane trees growing in a taffy swamp with cotton candy clouds in the background.

name: smwgraphics-candy-mimic
title: Candy Mimic
description:
This rip van fish reskin is a perfect fit for candy-themed levels or maybe, some unusual types of level. Don't be fooled by it's appearance, this candy is actually a mean mimic that wants to tear the player apart with its sharp teeth.

Credits should go to No Body The Dragon.

name: smwgraphics-candy-sweets-tileset
title: Candy/Sweets Tileset
description:
Feeling the need of something sweet? Then this tileset is for you. I did put the most effort on this one, the most important thing that there is no black outline. The .docx file gives the details. Give credit, if used.

Moderator's note: The layer 3 will conflict with the vanilla status bar. A Sprite Status Bar can be used to circumvent this issue. Furthermore the palette of the tileset does conflict with the goalpost, cement blocks and the likes.

name: smwgraphics-canyon
title: Canyon
description:
I made some canyon graphics..i don't like them very much,but before I delete them I'm uploading them here ;P
Credit isn't neccesary but would be nice ;)

title: Canyon/Bridge
description:
This is one of reghrhre´s SMBX tilesets (Version 3). It contends 2 ExGFX Files, a palette file and a .map16 file. I would recommend you to use both graphics in one level. You also could combine it with other graphics like the Ardy Lightfoot Canyon.

(c)reghrhre

Use this name in the credits.

It doesn't use many tiles, but is pretty versatile in how it can be set up.  It doesn't even need a custom palette and looks best with BG palettes 3 and 6.

name: smwgraphics-castle-horror
title: Castle-Horror
description:
This is an original BG created by me. There are 3 screenshots of the BG. You can view them above. Included 2 templates. They are required, in order to make a different castle/horror BG.
Give credit, if used. No readme needed, as it's easy to assemble.

description:

Note: You will need to use ExAnimation to change the back area color. While it will work like in the .ips, there are a few minuses:
Originally posted by LM help file
This should not be used. While technically it works, the overworld already uses the back area color for menus and the exit tile transition effect. Therefore the back area color shouldn't be used as part of your maps.

Anorakun's edit 02: Organized sample level, renamed EXGFX files to use uncommon numbers and added an useful uberasm code made by Donut, which adds parallaxing and hdma effects.

Please credit Donut for the parallaxing + HDMA effects bundled in this submission. Thanks.

name: smwgraphics-chocobo
title: Chocobo
description:
The Chocobo is a large, (usually) flightless bird from the Final Fantasy series that comes in many colors, famously yellow. I drew this Super Mario World-styled as a Yoshi replacement - it replaces Yoshi eggs and Yoshi-related signage as well. It does not require a custom palette. The hex edit needed to fix the lower half of the overworld sprite's palette is included for convenience, but can also be referenced in the ROM map. The tail feathers aren't so large and upright like much of the source series's material, but since this is within Yoshi's native framework, I'm not sure I can pull that off except with the credit Yoshies.

Anyone is welcome to expand or improve upon it and submit updates or variants without my permission.

name: smwgraphics-classic-desert
title: Classic Desert 2021
description:
Here's a desert tileset that includes SMB2-style pots, cacti based on the Pokey sprite, and several pieces that can be used with custom blocks. These include:
* Animated Quicksand
* SMB2-Style diggable sand
* Cracked Stone Block

name: smwgraphics-classic-factory
title: Classic Factory 2021
description: Here's a factory background based on FG Palette 2 (4 and 7 will also look pretty decent).  The electric barriers do nothing by default, but feel free to use some custom hurt blocks with them.

name: smwgraphics-classic-forest
title: Classic Forest 2021
description: Here's a lush forest foreground based on vanilla Palette 0.  It doesn't need a custom palette, but I included an optional autumn-themed palette in case you want to do an autumn forest stage.

name: smwgraphics-classic-forest-temple
title: Classic Forest Temple 2021
description: Here's a forest/jungle temple set with a bit of Dino-Rhino theming.  The open-mouthed statues could be used with a one-way sprite shooter if desired.

name: smwgraphics-classic-futuristic-highway
title: Classic Futuristic Highway
description: Here's a Sonic-inspired futuristic city/highway set based on FG Palette 2.

name: smwgraphics-classic-ghost-house
title: Classic Ghost House 2021
description: Here's a spooky ghost house tileset based on vanilla FG Palette 4.

name: smwgraphics-classic-goomba
title: Classic Goomba
description:
A simple set of graphics that replaces SMW's spherical Goombas with hand-drawn ones that more closely resemble their normal counterparts.

Replaces SP2. No custom palette or credit needed.

name: smwgraphics-classic-goombas
title: Classic Goombas
description: Here are some hand-drawn graphics to make your Goombas look more like actual Goombas.  The .zip includes graphics for the Goomba itself, its squished frame for those who wish to do the Tweaker/hex edit combo that turns SMW Goombas fully classic, and the frames for the Para-Goomba.

name: smwgraphics-classic-grassland
title: Classic Grassland 2021
description: This grassland was inspired by one of the fill patterns in Paint.net.  I used said pattern as a base for the dirt pattern here.  Everything else was drawn from scratch.  Like every set I've made with "Classic" in its name, this doesn't require a custom palette and is based on vanilla FG Palette 0.

name: smwgraphics-classic-graveyard
title: Classic Graveyard
description: I've been meaning to submit a graveyard set like this since 2011, but kept putting it off.  Oh well...Here it is now!  Like all my Classic foregrounds, this set is compatible with a vanilla palette.  In this case, said palette is FG Palette 0.

name: smwgraphics-classic-ice
title: Classic Ice 2021 Plus
description:
This package not only contains an ice/snow tileset in the style of the rest of my "Classic 2021" sets, but also a bonus file with graphics for snow-covered pipes and various frozen items, the latter of which can be used with Ersanio's Ice Block pack. The base tileset requires no custom palette, but the snowy pipes and frozen items do. The pipes and blocks are in a separate .map16 file in case you just want to use them.

The frozen itmes included are:
* Frozen Coin
* Frozen Muncher
* Frozen Yoshi Coin
* Frozen Springboard
* Frozen Key
* Frozen Keyhole
* Frozen P-Switch

name: smwgraphics-classic-ice-athletic
title: Classic Ice Athletic 2021 + Snowman Pokey
description: Here's an icy athletic set that uses vanilla palettes and includes line guides for line-guided sprites.  I also included graphics to turn Pokey into a snowman.  The snowman Pokey graphics do require a custom palette.

name: smwgraphics-classic-ice-cave
title: Classic Ice Cave 2021
description: Here's a cool icy cave set that uses FG Palette 5.  It includes some decorative crystals and flashing Christmas lights to hang on the ceiling.

name: smwgraphics-classic-ice-crystal-cave
title: Classic Ice Crystal Cave
description: This icy crystalline cave set uses vanilla Palette 5 and contains plenty of ice and crystal-themed setpieces.

name: smwgraphics-classic-jungle
title: Classic Jungle 2021
description: Here's a jungle tileset based on FG Palette 00.

name: smwgraphics-classic-lava-cave
title: Classic Lava Cave 2021
description: Here's a fiery cave tileset with lots of bones and animated lava flows.  It looks best with FG Palette 7, but 3 could also work.

name: smwgraphics-classic-moon
title: Classic Moon 2021
description: This lunar tileset is compatible with FG palettes 3, 4, 5, and 7.  It even includes evil stars a la Super Mario Land 2's Space Zone.  They turn into coins with a Silver P-Switch.  If using both the stars and standard spikes in the same level, it's best to use a custom hurt block with the latter.

name: smwgraphics-classic-mountain
title: Classic Mountain 2021
description: This mountain tileset features pine trees, bridges, and even railroad tracks.  It looks best with FG Palettes 3, 4, and 7.

name: smwgraphics-classic-ocean
title: Classic Ocean 2021
description:
This underwater set includes half-buried decorative Koopa Shells, animated seaweed, some shipwreck bits, and Jelectros that, by default, are set to turn into coins when a Silver P-Switch is pressed.

The treasure chests can even be used with a custom block like this.

name: smwgraphics-classic-overgrown-ruins
title: Classic Overgrown Ruins
description: Here's a ruins/temple tileset that's teeming with greenery and flowers.  It's compatible with Palette 0.

name: smwgraphics-classic-pyramid
title: Classic Pyramid 2021
description: Here's a desert pyramid set based on vanilla Palette 4. It features some of the same setpieces from my latest desert tileset, so you can use many of the same blocks. It also uses the same ExAnimation file.

name: smwgraphics-classic-ruins
title: Classic Ruins
description: Here's #11 in the Classic Foregrounds series, a ruins/temple set with some Muncher flair.  This set works with vanilla palettes 3, 4, and 7.  Palette 5 MIGHT be good if you're doing an ice temple.

name: smwgraphics-classic-sewer
title: Classic Sewer 2021
description: Here's a slimy, stinky sewer set based on FG Palette 1.

name: smwgraphics-classic-ship
title: Classic Ship 2021
description: Here's a ship tileset based on FG Palette 4 that includes pieces for both Koopa Airships and pirate ships.

name: smwgraphics-classic-sky
title: Classic Sky 2021
description: Here's a sky tileset that works with almost every vanilla.

name: smwgraphics-classic-snake-temple
title: Classic Snake Temple
description: Here's a pyramid/temple with a slight snake motif in the statues and torch sconces.  This is compatible with Palette 4, but might also look good with Palette 7 for a night theme.

name: smwgraphics-classic-swamp
title: Classic Swamp 2021
description: Here is a swamp tileset based on FG Palette 1.  It might be Shrek's, but it probably isn't.

name: smwgraphics-classic-water
title: Classic Water 2
description: This soggy set contains everything you need to build a typical water level, including corals, seaweed, blocks, and decorative oysters.  It even includes a couple treasure chests, and the small ones could be used with sprite-spawning custom blocks to hide power-ups.  This tileset is compatible with vanilla palettes and looks best with Palettes 1, 3, 4, and 7.

name: smwgraphics-classic-wham-bam-ruins
title: Classic Wham Bam Ruins
description:
Despite the name, this tileset draws most of its inspiration from Sonic 1's Labyrinth Zone. The Wham Bam part comes from the Wham Bam Rock graphic on one of the setpieces. This set requires no custom palette and will look best with vanilla palettes 3, 4, and 7.

UPDATE: I updated the Wham Bam Rock carvings to look more like his less-controversial Super Star Ultra design.

name: smwgraphics-classic-wood-castle
title: Classic Wood Castle
description: This is an expanded version of the wooden castle foreground seen in Mega Rex's Castle in Super Mario Outbreak.  It uses vanilla palette 4 and is perfect for tree fort levels.

name: smwgraphics-classy-airship
title: Classy Airship
description: An Airship with a Classy air in it, enjoy it.

name: smwgraphics-claymates-forest-yard
title: Claymates - Forest Yard
description:
TURNABOUT OMICRON: C3 THREAD

The Mountain with Forest background from "Claymates" SNES game.
The Green Pipe is incompatible with the background colors.
What do you think about this?

name: smwgraphics-clear-pipes
title: Clear Pipes
description:
Pipes that are transparent, Super Mario 3D World style. Can be used for decoration, or as screen scrolling pipes (necessitates the SMB3 Screen Scrolling Pipes patch).

They use background palette 0 by default, as this is how they fit best in a vanilla SMW environment, but implementing a custom palette shouldn't be too hard.

See the readme file on how to use in conjunction with the SSP patch.

description:
The Tediz from Conker, in their Live and Reloaded incarnation, I was about to make it a custom sprite, that shoots bullets, throws greneades and stuff, but since I can't code and program ASM, I just made it as Koopa replacement. Feel free to edit it as an ASM if you like.

Background used in the first mission (Zone A) in Cosmic Cop (Arcade).

This is a HUGE background, it uses basically every tile besides FG3 and animations from FG1 and FG2 (for make it vanilla-collectables/FG compatible) and also 4 palette rows. It's still usable overall, but keep this in mind.

This is a HUGE background, it uses FG2, BG1, BG2 and BG3, and also 3 palette rows. Keep this in mind.

name: smwgraphics-crash-bandicoot
title: Crash Bandicoot
description:
Crash Bandicoot in SMW style as a playable character.

I remember reading someone requested that on this forum.

I adapted it as best I could. It includes:

- Player GFX;
- Overworld map sprites
- Text name changed

Requires the 32x32 Player patch.

Warning! Overwrites colors used by Mega Moles, Monty Moles, Flying Question Blocks and other sprites that use palette 8.

You may need to remap them.

Background used in the "Velo's Challenge" race in Crash Nitro Kart (GBA).

Huge background, uses FG2, BG1, BG2 and BG3 (though only one palette row and 1/2 map16 page). You were advised!

name: smwgraphics-crate-and-delivery-marker
title: Crate and Delivery Marker
description:
I found it kind of awkward and confusing to have a key in a level, to be used for key jumps (or whatever else), that didn't have a keyhole. So to clarify that the sprite was simply meant to be used as a carriable platform/box I made this crate graphic that uses the existing vanilla SMW key pallet. I find it also does a better job showing the key's hitbox so you can stand on its edge a bit easier.

Buuuuut, I did add a delivery marker replacement for the keyhole, just in case Mario needs to deliver the box to get a secret exit.

Remember to lift with your knees.

pls credit me

name: smwgraphics-crazy-castle
title: Crazy Castle 3 - Garden
description:
The foreground of the first 15 levels in Bugs Bunny: Crazy Castle 3.

Includes a total of 15 palettes, since the original game uses one palette per level.

Mod note: Make sure to use GFX header Rope1 if you want the animated platforms to function like the moving ropes. Edited the sample level to reflect this.

name: smwgraphics-creepy-hydrocity-zone
title: Creepy Hydrocity Zone
description:
This tileset was released at Winter C3 2024. I am finally uploading it. Took most of my time to draw by usinga reference from Sonic Mania. Both BGs are original and even the tileset is original. Palette is easy to edit. Play with it. Use the sample level as reference. Both BGs and tileset are animated.

For layer 3, it's wise to use either a sprite status bar, custom status bar or the Remove Status Bar patch.

Have fun!

description:
One day, I was in a desperate need for a dialog box graphic for the info box sprite, since I was using NPC sprites that were larger than 32x32, which is the max size that wye's NPC sprites can handle. So I made this simple graphic with the goal of using it for very big NPCs, but it can be used for any type of NPC character you want or in case you don't want to use a custom sprite to do so. The colors used here are vanilla, so free feel to change the outline as your heart desires.

Do note that this submission doesn't include Rex, Mega Mole, Rainy Turtloid (Mega Man X6) and Goradus (Popful Mail (Super Famicom)). They are just used here to show how this simple info box graphic can be used.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.

If you set the define at the top of roto_disc.asm to !PaletteRotate = 1, then use PaletteRotate1.pal. This uses colors 3-5 on palettes 9-F, and it produces a slight shimmer on the border of the sprite.

If you set it palette rotate to 0, use PaletteRotate0.pal. The sprite will be a solid color, and by default it will use palette B.

name: smwgraphics-distinctively-square-overworld-graphics

description:
Hey did you remember the deadline for the overworld contest? I didn't.

This is a set of overworld graphics that I tried my best to make look real nice. They have a bunch of ordinary Mario features so they should probably meet at least some of your overworld needs.

Also: they're square. Amazing.

Moderator's note: it's already mentioned in the readme, but to clarify it further: the included ExGFX change the 8x8 tiles used by the vanilla Layer 1 tiles. If you only insert and load the ExGFX and palette files, your Overworld will be filled with garbage tiles due to the new graphics affecting the default Layer 1 tile, which in vanilla was completely transparent. To address this, you have to, in Layer 2 8x8 Editor Mode, copy the new 8x8 Layer 1 tiles (found below the submaps) from the sample BPS's Overworld to the same location within your Overworld, so your Layer 1 tiles will use those instead.

description:
Here's the background and layer 3 of ISO 9000 fully ripped. Features:

-you can view the sample level to see how both the BG and layer 3 are set up.
-the palette is organized and as a bonus, layer 2 uses palette 1 without affecting SMW colors.
-the BG is the least tile-consuming of the game as it uses 47 8x8 tiles. That easy.
-there are a total of 12 Map16 tiles. Again, it was very easy.
-layer 2 can be 512x512.
-layer 3 is a different story. Did manage to make that layer 3 use the last 2 GFX pages, as to prevent screwing up the SMW status bar. It uses 247 8x8 tiles.
-Both layer 2 and layer 3 have their own files required to insert.
-The last picture is a .gif with Mario running a bit on the test level.

Recommended BG scrolling: Variable for X and Y of layer 2 and none for layer 3 and Auto-Scroll Down Fast for vertical scroll, as that's how it was in the original game.

You may need a sprite status bar, disable the status bar with UberASM or remove it, since the falling page will get cutoff while using the vanilla status bar.

name: smwgraphics-earthworm-jim-snes-what-the-heck
title: Earthworm Jim (SNES) - What the Heck?
description:
Now it's the SNES version of Earthworm Jim - What the Heck, along with its layer 3. I had to fight 2 thingw here: one is frame 'fighting' of Evil the Cat and two is layer 3 management. After overcoming the challenges, I can say the backgrounds are done. In the original, the scrolling was slow, so you must find a way to set scrolling to slow or set it to none. If you check the in-game screenshot, you'll see that layer 3, while vanishing thanks to Remove Status Bar patch, is weirdly placed in front of layer 2. There's an explanation here. In the SNES EJ, the moon thing was placed behind the transparent layer 2, while the layer 3, being transparent at the bottom was in front of the BG and auto-scrolled. It's possible to simulate this in SMW, but you must be careful. Features:

-you can view the sample level to see how both the BG and layer 3 are set up.
-the palette is weirdly placed. It uses palettes 3, 5 and little bit of palette 1. Speaking of palette 1:
-it only uses 2 colors and placed those colors at layer 3 pslette 6 and 7. Those are the transparent colors, unaffecting SMW colors.
-layer 3 colors are easy to edit. Those don't affect SMW colors. It uses layer 3 palettes 3, 4 and 5.
-Bonus: Evil the Cat animates. Since I wasn't sure where the animations were, I decided to use the Genesis version and recolored tiles, so that it matches the SNES version and turned out good. Check the 1st picture.
-layer 2 can be 512x512 if so desired.
-layer 2 uses 402 9x9 tiles. It overwrites BG1, BG2, BG3 and a bit of FG1. You can't use bushes.
-BG uses 372 Map16 tiles. It almost overwrites 1 Map16 page and a half.
-layer 3 uses 384 tiles. You'd think it uses 3 ExGFX files, which is alraady a lot, but no, it uses 4 in total. I had to avoid tile FC here. It's 256x256 and you need DKCR Sprite Status Bar or Minimalist Status Bars patches.

You ca say it was version 1.0 above.

Version 1.12:
-fixed one of the blue eyes in one of Evil the Cat's animations. Now it's good.
-added transluscent fog to layer 3, which is better now.
-set both layer 2 and layer 3 X and Y scrolling to none for best results.
-extended the fog for layer 3. Anorakun said it cuts off.

name: smwgraphics-factory-castle
title: Factory / Castle
description:
This took a long time to draw. Here's what I did and followed the moderator's suggestions:

-changed the name of this tileset to an appropiate one;
-all the big barrels act like tile 100 above and tile 25 below and all small barrels act like tile 100;
-horizontal and vertical lasers animate now. I wanted to make them stationary, but that didn't work;
-'hill tripping' is removed now;
-fixed scrolling settings;
-added the moderator's color suggestion and re-organized the BG a bit;

-removed the white sparkles on the BG windows. Some SNES games kept those, but yeah did the change;
-layer 3 BG has been reworked now. Original clouds have been added, some inspiration from SMB3 and the lightning is way better.

If you do use the lightning, then make a custom block with it.

Use it with a custom status bar patch like the Minimalist Status Bar or the Super Mario Bros. 3 Status Bar for better results, since using with the SMW vanilla status bar causes cutoff in the layer 3.

Give credit, if used.

I hope you have fun using it (if you do).

name: smwgraphics-fatal-fury
title: Fatal Fury 3: Road to the Final Victory - 8x16 Dialogue Fonts
description:
This is 8x16 sized English alphabet font used in Fatal Fury 3: Road to the Final Victory. The game supports Spanish and Portuguese, so their orthography also comes in the fonts. This font works best against non-black, non-white background.

The orignal font had a minor mistake where the opening apostrophe was reversed, so I redrew and correct it.

BG2 sheet contains the basic English alphabets and sentence symbols, and BG3 contains the rest. If you're short on the space and want to only use English, you can omit BG3.

This font uses 3 monochrome colors, which are mapped to the same ones of "FG Palette 0" on Row 3. If you used the same palette set, they'll look fine.

description:
A simple forest tileset with feathers as decoration on the foreground. I tried to make them darker to not confuse the player with the real power-up.
If you want to use it, I recommend you to use this tileset in a level where you see for the first time the feather power-up in your hack.
Also, the layer 3 looks better with the 'wave' HDMA, so I recommend you to use this too.

Please give credits if used !

Note that some of the characters are made by me due that i didnt found them in the "latin small.png" and "zuish.png" and my pc is too bad to play the entire game just to find a character.

VERY IMPORTANT: DONT FORGET TO CREDIT PHIL FISH IN YOUR HACK BY THE ASM LVEL DESGIN MUSCI AND GEAPHICS OR HE WILL SUE YOU.

name: smwgraphics-fire-emblem-heroes-d-kk-lfheimr-realm-of-nightmares
title: Fire Emblem Heroes - Dökkálfheimr, Realm of Nightmares
description:
This collaborative foreground + background piece is based off Dökkálfheimr, the Realm of Nightmares from Fire Emblem Heroes. It originally was a request from me to Deeke at Winter C3 2021, until I drew the background and added more decorations.

This tileset is perfect if you want to create a level that takes place in an alien environment. It also contains the HDMA gradient needed to complete the visual aesthetic, and an alternate palette if you wish to use the forest background instead.

Note: Due to Layer 3 being on Subscreen, I highly recommend you use a different status bar, such as the Minimalist Status Bar or the DKCR-styled one.

No credit is necessary, but it is appreciated!

versions.title: Fire Emblem Heroes - Dökkálfheimr, Realm of Nightmares

name: smwgraphics-fire-emblem-heroes-d-kk-lfheimr-realm-of-nightmares-forest
title: Fire Emblem Heroes - Dökkálfheimr, Realm of Nightmares (Forest)
description:
This is the forest background of Dökkálfheimr, the Realm of Nightmares, from Fire Emblem Heroes. You may use it with the foreground here if you wish. This background, combined with the tileset is perfect if you want to create a level that takes place in an alien environment.

Note: Due to Layer 3 being on Subscreen, I highly recommend you use a different status bar, such as the Minimalist Status Bar or the DKCR-styled one.

No credit is necessary, but it is appreciated!

versions.title: Fire Emblem Heroes - Dökkálfheimr, Realm of Nightmares (Forest)

name: smwgraphics-fire-emblem-heroes-gacha-orb
title: Fire Emblem Heroes - Gacha Orb
description:
Evil gacha orbs that are used in the mobile game Fire Emblem Heroes. Debuted in my QLDC level, where I make a subtle critique about gacha hell and stuff. Per default, I've put it in the orb sprite (4A), but you can use it anywhere. Be aware that if you want to use in sprites like a Football, you need to use Tweaker or a disassembly to change the palette.

I did my best to reduce the colors of this orb, since it's a highly detailed PNG. I've reduced the image and then, passed SNESGFX to reduce its colors. Falconpunch did some slight adjustments to make the orb round.

Credit would be great, but is optional.

name: smwgraphics-fire-n-ice
title: Fire 'N Ice
description:
Submitted during Summer C3 2021!

This is a rip of a font used in Fire 'n Ice, also known as Solomon's Key 2 in Europe and Japan. Includes both for message box dialogues and for pre-credits cutscene.

name: smwgraphics-five-nights-at-freddy-s-freddy
title: Five Nights at Freddy's - Freddy
description:
This is Freddy Fazbear from the Five Nights at Freddy's series.

This is an updated version, with some changes to a few frames, such as the swimming animation.

Includes overworld, Yoshi, P-Baloon and cutscene frames, but no cape frames because it gets misplaced with these graphics.

There's a patch that will change Mario to Freddy in the file select and the "Mario/Luigi Start!" messages, though the lives exchanger text will not be edited because his name is 6 characters long.

The OW palette is to be inserted as a normal palette, in all maps. Player 2 will also a slightly brighter palette.

You'll need to apply the 32x32 player tilemap patch to use these graphics.

name: smwgraphics-five-nights-at-freddy-s-plushies

description:
The plushies of the original FNaF 1 animatronics (Freddy, Bonnie, Chica, Foxy and Golden Freddy), to be used as decoration.

Note: Chica doesn't have her cupcake. Also, if you're gonna use Foxy, you won't be able to use green berries.

title: Fix-It Felix Jr. - Intro
description: Background of the intro of the fangame Fix-It Felix Jr. (based in the movie Wreck-It Ralph). Might be useful for title screens or 8-bit based levels. Note that the background doesn't scroll horizontally (you can adapt it though, since the map16 is simple).

name: smwgraphics-fixed-bowser
title: Fixed Bowser
description: Just a "fixed" version of the Bowser (without looking like it was designed by someone who has never even seen the character), but still without uncharacterizing the SMW style

name: smwgraphics-flame-wheel
title: Flame Wheel
description: A japanese themed replacement for the Grinder. It's based on a youkai / monster called Wanyudo, a creepy flame wheel with a scary face. Luckily, this version does not have an uncanny face. Credits to No Body the Dragon. Uses vanilla palette.

name: smwgraphics-flappy-bird-city
title: Flappy Bird - City
description: The background seem in the infamous game Flappy Bird. I had to edit it a little so it could loop properly. Comes with the day and night themes.

name: smwgraphics-flappy-bird-grassland
title: Flappy Bird - Grassland
description:
Ripped from Flappy Bird for Android and iOS with foreground in-game stage, it was released on May 2013 by .GEARS Studios.

But unfortunately, his creator Dong Nguyen said that he "couldn't take" then removed for both from app store due to legal issues.

name: smwgraphics-flashback-legends-font
title: Flashback Legends - Font
description:
A futuristic-style 16x16 font inspired by a typeface found in the unreleased Game Boy Advance prototype of the game "Flashback Legends". Includes a full 26 characters (A-Z), numbers 0-9 and some punctuation.

Font uses vanilla palettes though I would recommend a custom one. A sample level and Map16 file are included for ease-of-use.

Suitable for credits, title screens, cutscenes or any other in-level text.

name: smwgraphics-flower-garden
title: Flower Garden
description: Here's a flower garden tileset with plenty of greenery to work with.  This would be a great World 1 tileset.

name: smwgraphics-flowery-grassland
title: Flowery Grassland
description:
Originally an update to my old ugly-looking grassland tileset. I decided that this one looks different enough from the other one, so I'm releasing it separately.

Features:
- Uses 100% vanilla palettes;
- Has dancing flowers (and Munchers);
- Grass;
- Doesn't make your eyes bleed like the old one;
- All in a single graphics file.

Unfortunately the sleeping Muncher has passed. Enjoy.

Includes both an FG and BG.
The BG requires HDMA to look as expected. The code to accomplish the effect for the BG is included, though it is built without consideration for BG vertical scrolling. As such, the Layer 2 and Layer 3 settings should be configured to NOT vertically scroll.

name: smwgraphics-ganbare-goemon-kirakira-d-ch-boku-ga-dancer-ni-natta-wake-aquann-castle-cave
title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Aquann Castle (Cave)
description:
The background seen in various sections of Aquann Castle and also seen in one of the final levels of the game.

MASSIVE UPDATE: Optimized GFX files, better map 16 organization, saner palette organization and now includes an extra variant.

Includes two palettes.

Due to the purple variant using much more colors, they use different map 16 files and palette.

Aquann Castle: palette rows 0 and 3.
Aquann Tower: palette rows 3 and 5.

Bundled with this submission is two parallaxing codes, meant to be inserted with UberASM Tool 2.1. Pick the one you need the most.

Please check the readme included to know what's the difference between these two uberasm files.

A good fit for cave levels.

versions.title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Aquann Castle (Cave)

name: smwgraphics-ganbare-goemon-kirakira-d-ch-boku-ga-dancer-ni-natta-wake-aquann-castle-underwater
title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Aquann Castle (Underwater)
description:
Another one of the backgrounds used in the Aquann Castle,from Ganbare Goemon 4. This one in particular is used in a shooting gallery, where Yae must used the enemy shooter to destroy some targets, so she can proceed even further in this bizarre place. It has a glass window that shows that the forstress of Aquann is underwater. An HDMA is included with it too.

Incompatible with the vanilla status bar. Please use any status bar patch you want.


Credit would be great, but is optional.

versions.title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Aquann Castle (Underwater)

name: smwgraphics-ganbare-goemon-kirakira-d-ch-boku-ga-dancer-ni-natta-wake-aquann-islands
title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Aquann Islands
description:
The beautiful background that appears in the stages 1 and 4 of Planet Aquann, from Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake, lit. "Under The Road - Why I became a dancer". Use it for water levels or levels with a japanese vibe. The original game doesn't have aquatic sections in the levels that use it, so use your creativity how you'll use this background.

Includes two HDMA: one used in Saqqas Forest (Planet Aquann stage 1) and another one used in Bungee Ridge (Planet Aquann stage 4). I did my best to align the HDMA with the backgrounds.

This background uses two entire palette rows, and the last 3 colors from palette 6.

Credit would be great, but is optional.

versions.title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Aquann Islands

name: smwgraphics-ganbare-goemon-kirakira-d-ch-boku-ga-dancer-ni-natta-wake-depths-lake
title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Depths Lake
description:
An underwater stage of Planet Impact, from Ganbare Goemon 4. It's an aquatic stage where Yae must cross a coral reef that has tons of dangers like spikes, scuba divers and nasty water currents. Like the name says, it's good for aquatic levels. To replicate the effect from the original game, I used a simple layer 3 + CGADSUB + Level Mode 0C + a horizontal wave HDMA.

May be incompatible with vanilla status bar. I recommend you to use a custom status bar.

Credit would be great, but is optional.

versions.title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Depths Lake

name: smwgraphics-ganbare-goemon-kirakira-d-ch-boku-ga-dancer-ni-natta-wake-desert-dunes
title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Desert Dunes
description:
One of the backgrounds used in planet Qubasa, from Ganbare Goemon 4. Like the name says, it's a great fit for desert levels.

Uses palette 3. BG2 and BG3 slots.

Credit would be great, but is optional.

versions.title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Desert Dunes

name: smwgraphics-ganbare-goemon-kirakira-d-ch-boku-ga-dancer-ni-natta-wake-diver-ridge
title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Diver Ridge
description:
The background of the first of planet Sweah, from Ganbare Goemon 4. This is a level about riding snow motorcycles to jump large gaps. At the top of mountain, the player must get a ride in the parachutist that drop from the enemy's airplane. It's a background that can fit ice levels, in general, mainly glaciers or plains. The original HDMA is included with it, as well.

Credit would be great, but is optional.

One of the interior backgrounds from Foresce Castle, of Ganbare Goemon 4. This section has an audience which shout words that can damage the player, and annoying cheerleader robots. Great for mechanical levels, overall. Or maybe a stadium?

title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Foresce Castle (Outside)
description:
An glommy Dark Forest seeing on the Outdoor Area of Foresce Castle from Ganbare Goemon 4. It uses Palette 0 (for the Layer 3), Palette 1 and Palette 3. Since that the Layer 3 Background is Big, it can be cut by the Status Bar, so if you use it, I suggest using either Sprite Status Bars (like Sprite Status Bar, NSMBWii Status Bar or DKCR Status Bar), Minimalist Status Bars or Remove Status Bar.

Requested by Anorakun.

One of the backgrounds used in the planet Foresce, from Ganbare Goemon 4. Like the name implies, it's a planet that is filled with forest and green. The original stage uses a flare lens effect, so maybe it should work with this background. It should be used for forest levels.

name: smwgraphics-ganbare-goemon-kirakira-d-ch-boku-ga-dancer-ni-natta-wake-qubasa-castle-baseball-scoreboard
title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Qubasa Castle (Baseball Scoreboard)
description:
A stadium scoreboard background from Ganbare Goemon 4. Uses only 81 tiles, meaning there's a lot of free space in the BG2 slot.

A good fit for stadium themed levels or bonus rooms, perhaps.

Update: Better palette row management and slots.

versions.title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Qubasa Castle (Baseball Scoreboard)

name: smwgraphics-ganbare-goemon-kirakira-d-ch-boku-ga-dancer-ni-natta-wake-qubasa-castle-baseball-stadium
title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Qubasa Castle (Baseball Stadium)
description:
One of the backgrounds used in the castle of Qusara Planet, from Ganbare Goemon 4. This game in specific is themed after various sports, while adding aliens to the mix. Baseball, football, bowling, ski, golf and etc. It reflects even in the enemies and lore. I don't know what this background can be used. The HDMA that the original game uses is also included, insert it with the Uberasm Tool.

Check the readme to insert the layer 3. I got help from MarioFanGamer to make this work, so thanks to him, as well.

WARNING! Incompatible with vanilla status bar! Use with a sprite status bar like the DKCR one or another custom status bar that you may like to use.

Or only use the HDMA, if you don't want to use the layer 3. It's located in the library folder. Also, using only the HDMA, you can use the vanilla status bar or any status bar you want.

Recommendend BG Scroll : None, None. The background doesn't loop, like in the original game.

Credit would be great, but is optional.

versions.title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Qubasa Castle (Baseball Stadium)

name: smwgraphics-ganbare-goemon-kirakira-d-ch-boku-ga-dancer-ni-natta-wake-qubasa-castle-soccer-field
title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Qubasa Castle (Soccer Field)
description:
The soccer field background from Ganbare Goemon 4. You may remember this from the second level of my hack, Qubasa Sport Field. Unlike the one used in my hack, this version has been fully optimized. A great fit for stadium themed levels, or in general, sports levels.

UPDATE: Reripped from scratch to make better use of color 0. Includes an uberasm HDMA gradient code that writes in color 0 or something by my friend Donut. Please insert the HDMA code with UberASM Tool.

Credit would be great but is optional.
