description:
The three backgrounds seen in Qubasa Road, from Ganbare Goemon 4.

Includes a fancy HDMA gradient, which is meant to be inserted with UberASM tool.

Layer 3 moons are also included. Please use it with Kevin's Ram Toggled Status Bar or any other patch / uberasm that removes the status bar.

title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Water Road
description:
Another of planet Aquann's background. This one has a distinction, because it has a floating Mt. Fuji in the background.

Massive update: Reripped from scratch, background is more accurate and complete, at the expense of using extra tiles.

This updated submission is meant to be used with Sonikku's Hammer Bro sprite. The files you'll find there are already included in this submission!!! I'm linking his work to give proper credit and so you know where to find extra info.


I needed to include the sprite's files here because I had to edit the sprite's tilemap and the "held" position of the hammer (in HammerBro.asm) as well as the palette to green (in HammerBro.cfg & .json). Aside from the .bin file, the rest of the files Sonikku provides are unmodified but they're still included here for convenience. Gloomy told me all this was justified and okay to do

Note: if you look at the GFX file, you'll notice there seems to be some regular bro tiles still. These belong to the Fire Bro, another sprite by Sonikku which uses these tiles only. These custom sprite graphics were included in the Hammer Bro's original .bin file. If you're new, know that you can just copy/paste my graphics into your own exGFX file, just make sure they're laid out the same! That is what we call "tileset mixing" my friend

name: smwgraphics-gokujou-parodius-snes-cat-battleship-forever
title: Gokujou Parodius (SNES) - Cat Battleship Forever
description:
I decided to combine the 2 BGs into 1. I did make a few improvements. Made the clouds and the island use the back area color, along with the high clouds. If you do change it, then make sure you change the underwater colors, too. One of the palettes fits well palette 1, so I moved it there without affecting SMW colors. The Map16 tiles have been improved as well.

Update: I ripped the BG again.
I merged the BG seen above and underwater into one. It does use a lot of tiles but I classify this as complete. A tile is used from the FG1 slot. I also:
-Updated the palettes. Clouds use palette 0 without affecting SMW palette, palette 3 is used for the ground underwater and ship+defeated penguin boss, palette 4 is used for the sand below and palette 6 is used for the islands. Uses the 2nd half of those palettes;
-Map16 went through its overhaul. I drew 2 new tiles for the underwater transition and added a few extra tiles for the islands and the small cloud;
-The octopus cloud was added as well.
You should use the BG according to the horizontal level settings from the sample level.

No credit needed. This did took some time.

name: smwgraphics-gokujou-parodius-snes-circo-porto-harborland
title: Gokujou Parodius (SNES) - Circo Porto Harborland
description:
The backgrounds seen in the first stage of Gokujou Parodius.

Includes two versions:
- First Half: it has the Circo Porto Harborland logo, the city at the background has an amusement park. It uses BG1, BG2 and BG3 slots and the palette rows 0, 3, 5 and 7. Heavy palette and graphic usage, even though there's a lot of space in BG3.

- Second Half: doesn't have the logo, the pillars have a beginning / end and the city is less varied. This version is the more recommended one to use. Uses only the BG1 slot and palette rows 3, 5, and 7.

Both versions can be used with the HDMA gradient file included in the zip file. Apply it with UberASM Tool.

Pick the version you're the most comfortable to use. Compared to the site version, my version (second half version) is much more optimized and accurate to the source material, along with better palette management.

"The name of this stage, "Circo Porto", originates from Konami's former chain of arcade and entertainment facilities in the early nineties."

A good fit for carnivals or cities.

name: smwgraphics-goomba

description: This is the first GFX file that I've made thats even remotely good. I figured I would submit it incase someone likes the style. This ZIP file contains two ExGFX files. One is the actual goomba GFX. This is all that most users will need. However, if you have squishable goombas, you will need to preform the remap hex edit, and use the GFX file marked optional. I've already placed the squished frame over the unused 5-up. Note that the custom palette included with this file is incompatible with yellow koopas. If you need yellow koopas and goombas in the same level, (or you're using the special world color change), then either recolor the GFX or remap the palette of one of the two sprites. name: smwgraphics-jikkyou-oshaberi-parodius-psx-boss-rush-first-and-second-bosses
title: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius (PSX) - Boss Rush (First and Second Bosses)
description:
You know how High Speed Patrol (Train Area) was the second worst and High Speed Patrol (Factory) was the first when it comes to adding it into LM with somewhat of an success? Now everything has changed as this BG of mine that comes from the Boss Rush section of JOP is now the absolute worst. First of all, I had to use 2 savestates for this BG, even though we know the BG is longer than it should be. It wasn't bad, but now comes palette management... oh boy. This BG did give me a great headache as not only I had to use many colors, but I had to use the Hue-Tolerance feature from the Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting Tool. Even if I did manage to get a good BG results, some tiles had bad colors. I had to correct it until it looked decent and used a palette for the upper part of the observatory tower. The archive includes an HDMA effect made with EffecTool. You can also edit the back area color anyway you like. You can use the BG according to the screenshots.

Uses the second half of palette rows 4 and 6.

Credit not needed.

versions.title: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius (PSX) - Boss Rush (First and Second Bosses)

The background seen while you fight Goemon's Compact, in the PSX version of Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius. Compared to the original version, i had to sacrifice a fair amount of details. Background scrolling should be disabled for this one and also, it's necessary a bit of ground to cover up the cutoff. A good fit for title screens, or boss arenas. Featured in Aeron's Golden Cookie Quest ~ Director's Cut.

Requires Remove Status Bar patch or any other sprite status bar alternative. Or if you don't like palette row 4, you just need to move the colors from row 0 to it.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.

- Customized GFX00 & GFX01. Feel free to replace the altered 'Nintendo Presents' Logo.
- Custom Overworld GFX (only Mario is edited).
- The only two GFX pages with Mario's blush. Why they needed two I will never know.

Not included:
- AA Batteries
- Custom Palette (how would I create a .pal file for a global palette?)
- Map16 pages ( . . . )
- Any sense of sanity.

name: smwgraphics-mario-luigi-bowser-s-inside-story-styled-cave
title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story Styled Cave
description:
Here is the custom graphics that I drew for the level "Yoshi Cavern" in Mario's Strange Quest. The file contains:

- BIS ? blocks
- BIS used blocks
- BIS message block (Emoglobin block)
- BIS style pipes
- A custom BG
- A Piranha Plorp sprite

The included sample level shows how the Emoglobin block animates, and it contains the palette.

V1.1 updates the look of the block and Emoglobin blocks to make them look a lot more like they do in BIS and slightly improves the pipe graphics. It also contains a Piranha Plorp sprite for the piranha plants as a bonus.

Note: I recommend that you use the redrawn cave FG graphics if you use the pipe graphics, since the ground around the pipe is drawn in that style.

name: smwgraphics-mars-bars
title: Mars Bars
description:
This is the second edition of the connected brown blocks I and others have adopted as a death block standard in recent years, a muncher-equivalent block free from both the limitations of munchers and the dullness of tiled anons.

This time, after years of avoiding it, I finally went through the trouble of adding extra tiles to round the funny looking inner corners. This is not the first time I’ve attempted this and I would describe it as an encyclopedic and pointless task but I’m pretty sure I’ve covered every possible configuration where there would otherwise be a little cutoff. It’s (slightly) more work to decorate this way, but for anyone who really cares about the details, these should look (slightly) nicer than the originals.

It’s recommended to use these with dacin’s muncher-size hurt/kill block to prevent breaks with powerups or silver p-switches.

They use 28 tiles in BG3 and the right side of the palette row. The test level provides anon-style example palettes with gray and red outline animations for hurt and kill respectively, but I encourage you to color them however you see fit.

name: smwgraphics-meatland
title: Meatland
description:
A meaty tileset that can be useful for any sort of fleshy atmosphere. Whether it be some sort of cave or inside of an actual living organism, we got you covered! Contains a FG and a layer 3 BG.

It's probably best to use a sprite status bar or some sort of status bar patch to make sure the top of the BG does not get cutoff.

Whoever suggested I make this, I'll be watching you :^)

name: smwgraphics-metroid-brinstar
title: Metroid - Brinstar
description:
A complete rip of the first area from the original Metroid. Everything from the original game should be accounted for.

Some notes:
-The cracked blocks and Item Spheres require a custom block that can be broken with projectiles. Such a block can easily be made using Blockreactor
-There are two different backs for the Chozo Statues, one of which is solid while the other is not. Only use the solid backside when the Chozo Statue is facing against a wall.
-The Zeb pipes and the tops of Chozo Statues are passthrough unlike the original game due to the lack of any kind of slab blocks, both in the vanilla SMW and in the Blocks section.
-The only used vanilla colors that are overwritten are the berry colors. No other non-blank colors are affected.

Credit to Mica for ripping the original tiles on TSR that I used as reference.

name: smwgraphics-my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-spike-the-dragon
title: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic - Spike the Dragon
description:
Hello, in July 2018, someone requested me to draw player graphics for Spike the Dragon from My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic. So I, DPBOX, worked with an artist, Mares-a-Mares, and, after almost a year of work, the graphics are complete, and here they are. I managed and Mares-a-Mares drew.

While most of these poses are original, like, 1 or 2 were ripped from My Little Pony: Rise of the Clockwork Stallions DX: Director's Cut https://www.dropbox.com/s/vcms2adkkqw3geu/My%20Little%20Pony%20Fan%20Games.zip?dl=0 and weren't changed, like, 4 more were ripped then modified slightly, but the rest are original, but either they started from the poses in that game then were heavily modified or were drawn completely from the ground up. All of the poses are based on that game's poses and use that game's style.

Please be aware that this is not a simple graphics swap. Some patches are needed. Everything you need to know to get these player graphics working is in the Read Me.

Credit goes to ExE Boss, Ladida, Neosz, and KilloZapit because the player requires some patches they made as well as yoshifanatic for helping me with some coding related things.

ATTENTION: Due to the fact that some of the patches required for these player graphics to work have been updated after I submitted this, I updated the Read Me. The Read Me is the only thing that was changed in this update, so if you downloaded this before, you don't need to download it again.

versions.title: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic - Spike the Dragon

description:
I ripped this from a demo called 'New Demo' made by a demo group called NESQuik(not to be confused with the milk brand).

This part was specifically ripped from the portion of the demo with a raster effect that repeats 1 scanline across the whole screen, and then changes the vertical position of the background within the scanline to make it look like parallax scrolling due to how the graphics look.

To apply the effect, add the included ASM through UberASM to a level using this background.

Here is video showing the code.

name: smwgraphics-paper-mario-the-thousand-year-door-vivian
title: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year-Door - Vivian
description:
A complete set of player replacement graphics. Vivian from Paper Mario: The
Thousand-Year Door. Includes frames for cape, overworld, castle animations
and blushing. I drew these myself from scratch.

Should preserve the switch block and Yoshi palettes correctly.

Use Lunar Magic's "Insert Shared Palettes to ROM..." to insert the shared
palette. This will overwrite the entire shared palette in the ROM. If you
don't want to do that, you can instead use Player_Palette_Patch.asm with an
ASM patcher such as Asar. The patch will overwrite only the player portions
of the shared palette.

If you're using Lunar Magic's custom palettes on the overworld, the custom
palette will override the shared palette, causing Vivian to appear in the
wrong colours. You can use "Import to current overworld submap palette from
file" with Overworld_palette.pal to update the player colours in your
custom palette. Make sure Overworld_palette.palmask is in the same directory
when you do this.

When walking left on the overworld, part of the Yoshi will flash red instead
of green (or whatever colour the Yoshi is supposed to be). Normally this is
hard to see because the parts affected are mostly obscured by Mario, save for
a few pixels. This is because some of the tile data was incorrectly marked to
use Mario's palette. However, since Vivian doesn't have feet, you can see
more of Yoshi and it's quite distracting. You may want to apply the included
patch "Yoshi_Overworld_Fix.asm" using Asar to fix it.

With great thanks to @mm102_ for the template and player exporter.[1]

I would love to know what you use this in! Find me on Twitter. Credit is
greatly appreciated.

I made 18 reskins, but the file would be too big, so I will upload them in 3 parts, each one containing 6. This one includes:

-Beartic-Inspired
-Carbink-Inspired
-Hatterene-Inspired
-Heracross-Inspired
-Magcargo-Inspired
-Marowak-Inspired

If you want to use all 3 animations of each Boss, look into the ReadMe file, the instructions are under 'How to use'.

A credit to me & Iceguy would be appreciated. And also to autisticsceptile1993, without his request, these Characters would've never existed in the first place.

Note: This tileset comes with a background which is meant to go with this foreground tileset to create a neat parallax scrolling effect when layer 2 horizontal scrolling is set to anything besides constant. Layer 2 vertical scrolling should be set to constant so that the background will always appear at the correct height.

Note: Graphics file 9B only contains the graphics for the giant "Welcome!" sign, making it optional if you want to use it or not. Which is good, because you can't use the original SMW's goal point in any area that uses that sign since most of the tiles found in FG2 get overwritten by the sign graphics, including the goal graphics. If you're using a custom goal in your hack that doesn't use those tiles, then this doesn't apply.

Note: The floating doors are meant to be used with a teleport block. If you're not using custom blocks, then they will serve more as decorations.

name: smwgraphics-readable-gothic-font
title: Readable Gothic Font
description:
Unlike the other generally stylized Blackletter gothic fonts I either create myself or on the rare occasion that I rip fonts from other video games such as Bloodstained - Curse of the Moon, this one goes into the former category of it being a font I made myself for a now-scrapped CLDC 2020 level entry that I couldn't finish in time that prioritizes readability over stylization, similar to how Pix3M did his Alagard font that I took heavy inspiration from to make this font.

There were minor touchups from the 2020 version as seen in the video linked on a few characters, mainly for readability purposes.

You are free to use this in whatever game or hack project(s) you have in mind, as long as you do credit me in your projects. To use this font in SMW, replace GFX2A in the Graphics folder with the downloaded font.

2022 UPDATE - Updated various letters upon seeing various Let's Plays and Twitch Streams of hacks that used this font, as there were certain letters that needed to be addressed further for readability's sake. depreciated.bin shows you the various alternative versions as well as the letters from the initial release that have been replaced.

name: smwgraphics-real-bout-fatal-fury-8x16-dialogue-fonts
title: Real Bout Fatal Fury - 8x16 Dialogue Fonts
description:
This is a selective collection of the English alphabet fonts used in SNK fighting game Real Bout Fatal Fury. It is sized 8x16 and works best against non-black, non-white background. This also comes with Spanish and Portuguese orthography.

BG2 sheet contains the basic English alphabets and sentence symbols and BG3 contains the rest. If you're short of space and only need to use English, you can omit BG3.

This font uses 3 monochrome colors, which are mapped to the global SMW palette on Row 4.

versions.title: Real Bout Fatal Fury - 8x16 Dialogue Fonts

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-bowser-castle-set
title: Redrawn Styled Bowser Castle Set
description:
A Redrawn-styled Bowser Castle set meant for interior and exterior areas, complete with foreground, background, and ExAnimation (both normal and Layer 3), which is inspired by various Mario games such as SMB3, NSMB (1+2), Mario RPG, Mario & Luigi 1 DX, and others.

Test levels (containing the ExAnimation data), palettes, and map16 files are included alongside the ExGFX files.

Note: While the Backgrounds are compatible with the Status Bar, the Layer 3 BGs are meant to be used with a non-layer 3 Status Bar or a HUD which doesn't cover the upper half of the screen with Layer 3 tiles. In any case, the backgrounds can be edited manually without issues to remove the top tiles should the user want to keep SMW's original Status Bar.

Give credit to me, SF - The Dark Warrior, and Icegoom if used.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-burner
title: Redrawn Styled Burner
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Super Mario Bros. 3's Burner custom sprite recreation from KobaBeach and an anonymous coder from VIP and Wall and Alaska Mix 5, meant to resemble the enemy's modern design.

A brief explanation is included on how to change the sprite's palette, due to being hardcoded in the sprite itself rather than in its respective .json files.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-clawgrip
title: Redrawn Styled Clawgrip
description:
Custom graphics for Sonikku's SMB2 Clawgrip custom sprite, meant to be used alongside Icegoom's redrawn graphics.

Just like the main sprite, it uses SP3 and palette C by default, while his rock proyectile uses palette 9 instead (a custom one is included in any case).

Give credit if used, as it's always appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-cloud-tileset
title: Redrawn Styled Cloud Tileset
description:
For those redrawn style enthusiasts, this pack that promises to expand the original cloud stuff from Super Mario World Redrawn may be useful.

It adds new faces and sizes for the original redrawn cloud stuff from SMWR, useful if you want to create a cloud section or just make your hack more varied.

It uses palette 7 from SMWR (so if you're using this hack graphics the palette included isn't necessary), and a great map16 slot.

Also includes upside down versions for each cloud, which act as 1C8 (but being a bit glitched).

NOTE 1: Tile 3F7 just mimics the original cloud (happy and upside up), so you can ignore it and use global tiles cloud if you want.

NOTE 2: The pack also includes GFX14 from SMWR that contains the redrawn cloud graphic if you're not using SMWR.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-fire-chomp
title: Redrawn Styled Fire Chomp
description:
For use with edit1754's Fire Chomp sprite.

A Redrawn-styled SMB3 Fire Chomp for use in SMW Redrawn-styled SMW hacks. Comes in two main versions based on mouth shading, further divided by head animations, and fire palette.

See information.txt for more details.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-fryguy
title: Redrawn Styled Fryguy
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Sonikku's SMB2 Fryguy custom sprite, meant to be an amalgam between his official artwork and Super Mario All-Stars/Super Mario Advance in-game design.

It comes with 2 different type of variations for his fire projectiles.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-ghost-guy-snufit
title: Redrawn Styled Ghost Guy & Snufit
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for the custom sprite recreations of the Ghost Guy (bu smkdan) and Snufit enemies (by RussianMan) respectively.

Multiple variations are included depending on what palettes the Snufits look best with (+ one that invokes the enemy's design from Super Mario 64). Similarly, the Ghost Guy has 2 variations based on whether its mask is closer to Icegoom's Shy Guy, or if it uses a custom mask of my own design.

Finally, the custom palette included also comes with a palette for the Ghoul Guy variation of Ghost Guy seen in Mario & Luigi: Partners in Time. As this one's set in Palette E, using it requires changing Ghost Guy's color through PIXI's CFG editor to apply it.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-hoopster
title: Redrawn Styled Hoopster
description: A redrawn version of this sprite, it comes with some variants so you can choose the one you like the most, the red one uses the original red palette from redrawn, the one with black spots is meant to ressemble the in game sprite Hoopster had in other games, the one with pink spots is based on artworks, and the yellow one is how the enemy looked like in Super Mario Advance 1.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-hurt-death-block
title: Redrawn Styled Hurt/Death Block
description:
A redrawn styled death block useful for signaling a hurting block. It acts as 12F (the piranha plant act as that hurts the player) but you can set it as 130, 25 or whatever you want.

It uses only 3 tiles from BG3 so probably won't take up much slot, and uses the blank part of palette row 7 (along with black and white used colors).

You can also use this graphic for custom blocks like this and this.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-jelectro
title: Redrawn Styled Jelectro
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for the SMB3 Enemy/Solid Hazard Jelectro, meant to resemble the jellyfish's official artwork.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-joe-the-shark
title: Redrawn Styled Joe The Shark
description: A redrawn styled version of this sprite, It comes with two variants for grey and blue palettes and 3 other variants for how the vertical Joe looks, They were based on how they looked in their Super Mario Land 2 artworks.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-koophd-pack
title: Redrawn Styled KooPhD Pack
description:
A custom pack based on Iceguy KooPhD's custom sprite. It comes with graphics meant to go along with Icegoom's redrawn style that can be used for both the custom sprite in question, and also the normal SMW Koopa and all of its variants (shell-less, super, net, etc.).

The normal KooPhD graphics use SP1 to SP4, while the custom sprite - including its vial projectile- uses only SP3. Also included are 4 versions of the graphics meant for SP3: 2 where KooPhD's vials use either normal or smear frames when thrown; and another 2 where the custom sprite is in full lab coat and lacks a shell (for those who want the custom sprite to be visually distinct from the normal KooPhDs).

Custom palettes for all 4 possible KooPhDs are included as well.

Give credit if used, as it's always appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-lava-lotus
title: Redrawn Styled Lava Lotus
description:
A redrawn styled version of this sprite and this sprite , It's meant to ressemble their artwork in Super Mario Bros 3.
Sonikku's sprite comes with two options, one with a green stalk and one with a turquoise stalk.
Unfortunately, Davros sprite has a small problem with how the tiles are assembled that I can't fix myself (specificaly the middle tiles), the graphics are still definely usable though.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-masked-net-koopas
title: Redrawn Styled Masked Net Koopas
description:
Redrawn-styled Masked Net-Climbing Koopas, originally drawn by BigPotato for October Ordeal on request, now released (with permission) for use in SMW Redrawn-sty;ed hacks.

This is intended to be used with sprite graphics that reflect the state of Special World upon completing Funky, but it can be used standalone.

Give credit to BigPotato for the graphics.

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Masked Net Koopas
versions.filename: redrawn styled net masked koopas RC1.zip

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-mekabon
title: Redrawn Styled Mekabon
description:
Custom graphics for smkdan's Mekabon custom sprite, meant to be used alongside Icegoom's redrawn graphics. Comes with a custom palette 9.

Give credit to me if used, as it's always appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-monty-mega-mole-pack
title: Redrawn Styled Monty/Mega Mole Pack
description:
Custom redrawn graphics for every version of the Monty Mole & Mega Mole enemies featured in Super Mario World which use their modern appearance.

This pack features graphics for the following sprites:

* SMW Monty Mole.
* SMW Mega Mole.
* Wacky/Rock, Stone & Bomb Throwing Mole (Custom Sprite) by leod.
* Ledge-Dwelling Mega Mole (Custom Sprite) by Erik.
* 64x64 Mega Mole (Custom Sprite) by Ixtab.
* Mega Mole, but Sloped by Sonikku.

All the Mega Mole enemies contain an extra variation of them wearing shades.

Also, extra graphics are included for the hole the Ledge-dwelling Mega Mole sprites leave which match SMW Redrawn's normal grassland tileset.

Finally, the palette included covers palette 2 (used for the foreground by default), 8 (which replaces the color of Mario/Luigi's shoes), A (used by the Wacky Mole's bob-omb proyectile), and E (used by the Wacky Mole's rock proyectile).

Credit's not necessary but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-mouser
title: Redrawn Styled Mouser
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Dispari Scuro's SMB2 Mouser custom sprite, meant to resemble the enemy's official artwork.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-pecan-pelican-brother-fish
title: Redrawn Styled Pecan/Pelican Brother + Fish
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Shwa's Wario Land Pecan/Pelican Brother custom sprite + its fish projectile, meant to resemble both the enemy's concept artwork and its Wario Land 1 design.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-phanto
title: Redrawn Styled Phanto
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Sonikku's SMB2 Phanto custom sprite, meant to resemble the enemy's modern design.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-pirate-themed-koopa-troop-family
title: Redrawn Styled Pirate-Themed Koopa Troop Family
description:
Arrgh! Hear ye mateys! These Koopas (and Goombas) are here for ya needs to make a level involving setting sail on the high seas or other places* ye pirates hang with.

Extract the graphics to their respective SP# slots.

For SMW Goomba (Galoomba) use, remap the palette to row D for the Goomba sprite with STEAR, as that was what icegoom intended for such graphic in the original, it is the same here.

*BG, player character, and tileset not included, they may or may not be released at a future time.

Give credit to me and BigPotato if used.

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Pirate-Themed Koopa Troop Family

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-ptooie-spike-ball
title: Redrawn Styled Ptooie + Spike Ball
description:
Custom redrawn graphics meant for Romi's SMB3 Ptooie Piranha Plant custom sprite, as well for the spike ball the enemy uses.

A custom palette for rows 9, C and D is included.

Finally, the spike ball itself is Exanimated, so a test level + screenshot has been included for the sake of helping setting it up better.

Credit's not necessary but heavily appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-reznor-family
title: Redrawn Styled Reznor Family
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for the whole Reznor family, meant to resemble the dino's redesign from New Super Mario Bros 2. This pack includes:
* Graphics for SMW Vanilla Reznor + the platform they're in.
* Graphics for Koopster's Baby Reznor custom sprite.
* A custom Sprite Palette 2, meant to be used with the family.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-rideable-balloon
title: Redrawn Styled Rideable Balloon
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for Yoshi Island's Rideable Balloon custom sprite recreation from smkdan. It comes with 2 variations; normal, and with a blush.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-rocky-wrench
title: Redrawn Styled Rocky Wrench
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics meant for the Rocky Wrench custom sprite (both Sonikku and Koyuki's versions), which come in 2 variations:

* Classic: Based on their SMB3 & Mario Kart 8 DX DLC appearance.
* Monty: Based on their look in the NSMB and Paper Mario series (ie. look like modern Monty Moles).

Each version comes with their own custom palettes due to some variations using slightly different color rows than others.

Credit's not necessary but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-sea-pokey
title: Redrawn Styled Sea Pokey
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Darolac's Sea Pokey custom sprite, allowing the boss to fit right in with the Super Mario World Redrawn art style.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-serpont
title: Redrawn Styled Serpont
description:
A redrawn version of this sprite, the standart version for their graphics uses palette 8 for their pot (to ressemble their design in wonder), but you can use a lot of other palettes as seen in the screenshots, there's also a version of the graphics with an orange pot to ressemble their original graphics and a custom purple palette that goes over palette B.
Note that you should use the sprite's extension to customize the appearence of the pot, for the standart appearence I used: C0 and 21 for the two first values, C0 being the tile for the pot, 2 being the tile priority and 1 the palette the tile should use.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-shymore-shyster
title: Redrawn Styled Shymore/Shyster
description:
Redrawn-styled graphics for imamelia's Super Mario RPG Shymore/Shyster Custom Sprite recreation, meant to make the enemy fit its more modern design from the Super Mario RPG Switch remake.

Multiple variations are included depending on what palettes the Shy Guys riding the claymore-looking pogo-sticks look best with. Variations A to D use Icegoom's masks for Super Mario World Redrawn's Shy Guys, while variations E & F use a custom mask of my own design.

Similarly, 3 different custom palettes are included which give the pogo-sticks different colors: green, red, and gray/silver.

Credit's not required but heavily appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-skeeter
title: Redrawn Styled Skeeter
description:
Redrawn style graphics for the Skeeter custom sprite.
It includes alternate designs the enemy has had in other games, and also includes extra frames for dropping a bomb like they do in New Super Mario Bros.
Also should note that Bomb Skeeter and Modern Skeeter need file editing since they use pal F (pink palette).

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-spark
title: Redrawn Styled Spark
description: A redrawn styled version of this sprite, It comes with variants for the Doki Doki design and Yoshi's Island design.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-spike
title: Redrawn Styled Spike
description:
Redrawn-styled Spike as seen in SMB3 and Super Mario Maker 2. Made by BigPotato, Deeke, and I, for use in your SMW Redrawn-styled hacks.

Comes in primarily two versions, one for mikeyk's Spike sprite, the other for EternityLarva's version based off of SMM2.

Please read info.txt for more detailed information and instructions.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-spiny-cheep-cheep
title: Redrawn Styled Spiny Cheep Cheep
description: A redrawn styled version of this sprite, it comes with two versions, one being their modern design and the other being their old design; Uses palette B

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Spiny Cheep Cheep
versions.filename: Redrawn Styled Spiny Cheep Cheep (SP2 and SP3).zip

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-spiny-fish-porcu-puffer-boss
title: Redrawn Styled Spiny Fish & Porcu-Puffer Boss
description:
A redrawn styled version of the Spiny Fish from Yoshi's Story, and the Porcu Puffer Boss from Mario Pinball Land, they replace Cheep Cheeps.

You may need to remap the Cheep Cheep palettes if you pick the variants that use palette rows E or F.

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Spiny Fish & Porcu-Puffer Boss
versions.filename: Redrawn Spiny Fish and Porcu-Puffer Boss.zip

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-super-mario-bros
title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Bros. 3 Nipper Plant
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Super Mario Bros. 3's Nipper Plant custom sprite recreation from imamelia, meant to resemble the enemy's modern design.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Bros. 3 Nipper Plant
Redrawn Styled Super Mario Bros. 3 Lakitu
Redrawn Styled Super Mario Bros. 3 Hammer Bros. Family
versions.filename: redrawn hammer bros release candidate rc1.zip

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-super-mario-bros-grassland
title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Bros. Grassland
description:
A reshaded and recolored version of the grassland tileset used in Super Mario Bros. (only the main tiles).
I modified the ledges, the background (clouds, hills), some blocks and the foreground. Flagpole and small castle are not included.

It includes an ExGFX file, a palette file, and 2 map16 files.
Please give credits if used.

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Bros. Grassland

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-super-mario-land-enemies-pack
title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Land Enemies Pack
description:
This is a pack that contains graphics for most of Super Mario Land 1 enemies in Redrawn style.
A lot of them have custom sprites in the site made by smkdan (Gunion replaces the Sunshine Blooper)

Since the site does not accept enemies without corresponding sprites, these have been included in my profile files.

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Land Enemies Pack

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-super-mario-land-fly
title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Land Fly
description:
Custom graphics for smkdan's Super Mario Land 1 Fly custom sprite, meant to be used alongside Icegoom's redrawn graphics.

Comes in 3 different designs: Classic (meant to use Palette B); Mario & Luigi's (meant for Palette D); and Super Mario Land's (which goes with Palette A). Custom palettes for all three varations are included, but be aware you'll need to edit the sprite's .cfg file if you want it to use palette B/D.

Give credit to me if used, as it's always appreciated.

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario Land Fly

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-super-mario-world
title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island Piranha Plants + Needlenose
description:
Custom redrawn graphics for every version of the Yoshi Island custom sprites... plus the Pokey-like proyectile fella one of the variations of the plant shoots to the player.

This pack features graphics for the following sprites:
* Dynamic YI Piranha Plant & Wild Ptooie Piranha by SMWEdit & spooonsss.
* Non-Dynamic YI Wild Ptooie Piranha (includes the Needlenose/Pokey proyectile) by Smkdan.

It also includes custom palettes used by each version of the sprite. The main difference between both is that the Dynamic variants use palettes A, C & D (1st and 2nd half), while the non-dynamic Ptooie uses A, B, C & D's palettes. Meanwhile, the cactus guy uses palette A.

The 1.1 version now includes a variation of the graphics in which the plants sport brown/red-ish heads and colored lips (think of how they once looked around the Super Mario 64 - Mario Party 6 era).

Credit's not required, but very much appreciated.

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island Piranha Plants + Needlenose
versions.filename: Redrawn Yoshi Island Piranha Plants + Cactus 1.1.zip

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island Bumpty

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-tap-tap
title: Redrawn Styled Tap-Tap
description:
A redrawn version this sprite, comes with two versions, the first one is a newer version I made more recently, the second one is an older attempt I did at redrawing the Tap-Taps wich looks closer to the Yoshi's Island graphics.

They come with four variants each: blue shoes, red shoes, one that only uses 8 colors and one that's compatible with more common palettes like pal A, B, C or D (the green palette shown here is more so for show since it can also be used with original SMW palettes).

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-tryclyde
title: Redrawn Styled Tryclyde
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Dahnamics' SMB2 Tryclyde custom sprite, meant to resemble the enemy's official artwork.

It comes with 2 different variations for the fire projectile it's supposed to spawn.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-tweeter
title: Redrawn Styled Tweeter
description:
Tweeter from SMB2 (US)/Doki Doki Panic in the SMW Redrawn Style. Comes with variations. See the "important information.txt" for more details.

Give credit to me and Moltz for use in your (preferably) Redrawn-Styled projects.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-wart-boss-area-tileset
title: Redrawn Styled Wart + Boss Area Tileset
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Roy's SMB2 Wart custom sprite meant to resemble the boss' official artwork, as well for the sprites related to his fight, and his boss room's foreground.

Wart himself comes in 2 variations differentiated by the type of eyes he sports. Beyond that, custom palettes are included which either cover the whole package, or only contain the palette used by Wart, his projectile, and the veggies spawned from the machine. Finally, a level containing a recreation of Wart's boss room is also included.

Credit's not necessary but greatly appreciated regardless.

versions.title: Redrawn Styled Wart + Boss Area Tileset

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-yurarin-boo
title: Redrawn Styled Yurarin Boo
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for smkdan's SML Yurarin Boo custom sprite, meant to resemble the enemy's official artwork.

It comes in 2 flavors: Classic (meant to work with any palette); and Artwork Accurate (meant to go with SMW Redrawn's Palette A, thus requiring some prior tinkering with Pixi's CFG editor).

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-yoshi-s-island-enemies
title: Redrawn Yoshi's Island Enemies
description: Redrawn Yoshi's Island graphics that belong to SP4.

name: smwgraphics-reindeer-yoshi-and-baby-yoshi
title: Reindeer Yoshi and Baby Yoshi
description: Custom yoshi sprites, kitting him out in some festive reindeer gear. Included is the file for his gameplay sprites (GFX33) & ending cutscene graphics (GFX26). Baby yoshi is also changed to match.

name: smwgraphics-rendering-ranger-r2-stage
title: Rendering Ranger R2 - Stage 7 (City)
description:
TURNABOUT OMICRON: C3 THREAD

The city background from "Rendering Ranger R2" SNES game.
What do you think about this colossal city background?

versions.title: Rendering Ranger R2 - Stage 7
versions.filename: Rendering Ranger R2 - Stage 7 City layer 3.zip

versions.title: Rendering Ranger R2 - Stage 5 (Second Section)
versions.filename: Rendering Ranger R2 - 2nd BG Stage 5 layer 3.zip

name: smwgraphics-replenished-grassland
title: Replenished Grassland
description:
No credit is needed, for this was a relatively easy rip. In fact, expect MORE rips from Crazy70 by me.

Thanks for downloading!

name: smwgraphics-reset-pipe-and-arrow-blocks
title: Reset Pipe and Arrow Blocks
description:
Custom made stuff from an old hack. Includes reset pipes, arrows, cracked bricks, and a cement block variation.

Remapped to use BG3.

name: smwgraphics-resplendent-crystal-cave
title: Resplendent Crystal Cave
description:
A set of crystal cave graphics with a matching BG on layer 3.

The FG includes animated lava. It also includes a lava glow for use on translucent layer 2, and the crystals work well on translucent layer 2.

There is a less crystally variant of the FG (using the same map16 and everything), in case crystals aren't your jam re: caves, but it is less featured than the crystal version. In particular, the BG is only available in crystal flavor.

Some (minor) tiles are designed to go with my Resplendent Global Graphics.

name: smwgraphics-resplendent-ghost-house
title: Resplendent Ghost House
description:
A big set of ghost house graphics, including an FG, several variations on a BG, and two layer 3 BGs. The FG features an animated clock. The BG features animated lights. The set is intended to mix and/or match conveniently and includes enough graphics for some kinds of castle.

To use the layer 3 BGs you will want some kind of patch to either make the status bar work properly with layer 3 on subscreen or remove it.

name: smwgraphics-resplendent-global-graphics
title: Resplendent Global Graphics
description:
Replace the global graphics in SMW, like pipes and question blocks, with graphics that I drew, and think are prettier.

These graphics are mostly one-to-one replacements for SMW things, with the exception that I replaced the bush with some extra tiles I think are more useful - a mushroom platform, wide cloud, vine end, etc.

Swapping out one of the files lets you replace the diagonal pipe and climbing nets with some SMB3 stuff.

name: smwgraphics-resplendent-grassland-sets
title: Resplendent Grassland Sets
description:
Sets of grassland graphics, all intended to go together, including an FG, three BGs, and two layer three BGs. The FG includes animated flowers and grass. The blue hill BG features animated clouds.

Some tiles are designed to go with my Resplendent Global Graphics.

Moderator's note: requires this patch for the status bar to not appear behind other layers. Alternatively, use a sprite status bar patch.

name: smwgraphics-retro-half-bolded-arcade
title: Retro Half-Bolded Arcade '80 Font
description: Arcade typeface from a few weird and bizarre early 80s games (including Destroyer, Draco and Altair) by Cidelsa, likely derived from Gremlin. Except lower cases and a few symbols.

name: smwgraphics-retro-style-castle
title: Retro-Style Castle
description:
This is a retro-style castle foreground.

It includes a NES palette and a GameBoy palette.

It fits well for retro castles or temples/dungeons.

You don't have to give credit but it would be better if you did.

name: smwgraphics-retry-neon-nights
title: Retry - Neon Nights
description:
Graphics based from a forgotten Rovio mobile game named "Retry". This graphics comes from the game futuristic world, and the name came from the music heard on the same levels.

Should be used on abstract or industrial levels.

Uses the second half of palette rows 4 and 5.

Credit not required, but very appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-rhythm-tengoku-sneaky-spirit
title: Rhythm Tengoku - Sneaky Spirit
description: A Sneaky Spirit from Rhythm Tengoku, sneakily replacing Torpedo Ted.

name: smwgraphics-rick-dangerous
title: Rick Dangerous 2 - Fat Guy Headquarters (Underground)
description:
C3 SUMMER 2021 SUBMISSION:

The Underground section of the final level from Rick Dangerous 2.
Perfect for caves, castles or hideouts.

name: smwgraphics-rick-van-fish-and-morty-mole
title: Rick Van Fish and Morty Mole
description: Wubba Lubba Dubb Dub, a replacement for the monty mole and rip van fish.

versions.title: Rick Van Fish and Morty Mole
versions.filename: rick van fish and morty mole.zip

name: smwgraphics-rideable-p-balloon
title: Rideable P-Balloon
description: A 32x32 p balloon for smkdan's Rideable Balloon sprite. A palette file and separate ExGFX file are included that use the p balloon's original colours.

name: smwgraphics-rising-balloons
title: Rising Balloons
description:
I thought I already submitted this, but apparently, I didn't.

This is a Layer 3 background with balloons that rise via vertical Layer 3 autoscroll. For best results, a sprite Status Bar is strongly advised.

name: smwgraphics-ristar-bonus-stage
title: Ristar - Bonus Stage
description:
A space themed background seen in the bonus stages from Ristar. Credits isn't needed, but would be appreciated.

Moderator's Note: You must insert the palette file to get the correct colors, simply using the level file will not import the correct palette.

name: smwgraphics-ristar-level-select
title: Ristar - Level Select
description:
-Slots Used: FG2/BG1/FG3
-Description: A fairly big, space themed background which could find a nice use for "space pop" like levels.

name: smwgraphics-ristar-planet-flora-light-plain
title: Ristar - Planet Flora (Light Plain)
description: Lush jungle lake background. Might be nice for something

name: smwgraphics-ristar-planet-freon-itamor-lunch
title: Ristar - Planet Freon - Itamor Lunch
description: Okamikurainya ripped this. Converted for SMW usage. Credit goes to him. Uses almost a palette and about 1 GFX file and a half.

name: smwgraphics-ristar-planet-freon-pure-white
title: Ristar - Planet Freon - Pure White

name: smwgraphics-sanae-kochiya

description:

The Player 2 palette is Reimu Hakurei.
The fire palettes for each player are white haired "Mokou" Sanae and PC-98 Reimu respectively.

Includes the following files:
- GFX00.bin (Big player extra sprites)
- GFX10.bin (Map player)
- GFX22.bin (Small kiss blush)
- GFX24.bin (Big kiss blush)
- GFX28.bin (Hud text: "SANAE" & "REIMU")
- GFX32.bin (Player graphics)
- sanae_shared.pal (Shared player palette)

- yoshi_ow_fix.pal (Fix for Yoshi's overworld palette. To apply, import to every overworld submap using the Green Star + Red Arrow button in Lunar Magic)

Please note that the art style is not "smw styled", so it may not be entirely accurate to vanilla.


If you just want to play vanilla smw as Sanae, consider using this "Super Sanae World" bps patch instead. It has been patched to fix all text and adds other Sanae-related gfx changes (custom title screen & "The End" picture)

name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-dragon-palace
title: Sexy Parodius - Dragon Palace
description:
A simple and very nice tileset from Sexy Parodius. This game has two stage 3: one being Castle Dracula, and the other one being an underwater palace. This specific stage is based in Yie Air Kung-Fu, one of the first fighting games in history, made by Konami. The ramen bowls in the original game is where chinese dragons spawns to attack the player. A good fit for chinese / eastern based levels.

Credit would be great, but is optional.

name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-happy-coins

description:
The beautiful and shiny coins from Sexy Parodius. They appear in two missions. Since everything tends to be frenetic and chaotic in Parodius, it's very easy to die while trying to accomplish the mission of collecting these shiny, yet deadly coins.

Updated exanimation destination. Changed palette row.

Credit would be great, but is optional.

name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-psx-bath-house-boss
title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Bath House (Boss)
description:
Originally, I wanted to rip the stage 1 BG from Sexy Parodius as debut, but since PSX-View had no ability to save a screenshot using a button as far as I know, (I may come back to it when I can.) I decided to go for the stage 2 boss BG where the player ship fights Finally Penguin. I removed the candles as not only those weren't able to have their own palette as I ripped the BG with Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting Feature, but I also edited the BG in Aseprite to remove the blocks at the very top and bottom and replaced those with the tiles seen in PSX-View. Use it in either a level end section or a boss fight. You can technically have horizontal scrolling if set to a really slow value such as Slow or Slow 2.
Enjoy as it took a lot from me.

name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-psx-bath-house-far
title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Bath House (Far)
description:
This BG is seen in stage 2 of Sexy Parodius. Had trouble with this BG at first. The rest of the parts were sprites. Fortunately, it was easy to insert into SMW wtih near accurate results.
You can easily add a layer 3 space or sky BG or otherwise.

No credit needed.

name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-psx-castle-dracula
title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Castle Dracula
description:
Originally, this BG was only meant to be used for horizontal scrolling. However, I decided to complete it with tiles that meant to be used with vertical scrolling. Result is good. I used Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting feature a 2nd time, because the first time when I added the BG into LM, I did notice some reds I didn't spot into Aseprite. How can you blame me. Those did look the same. Corrected this glitched behaviour of the BG with the color green and added the proper red color for the BG.
Uses 2 palettes. I thought it'd use more.

No credit needed.

name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-psx-coal-mine-outside
title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Coal Mine (Outside)
description:
Here's another BG encountered after you fail Castle Dracula in Sexy Parodius. When I tried ripping this BG, I failed because of the number of colors.

I tried again later, this time with good results.

Still, because this BG uses way more tiles than needed, since it comes from a Playstation game, I had to apply the Touhou formula.

I kept on flipping many tiles and removed few tiles for a repeatable tile. I also removed the stars for an easier time.

Used Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting feature and did corrections.

Used the second half of palette 6 to correct the tree and its stump since the result gave me a blue one and decided to bring the stars from the game back. This BG uses the unused tile B.

The stars use palette 0.

The BG overwrites bushes, diagonal pipes, triangle and transluscent blocks and net tiles. The rest of the tiles can be used.

Also uses the second half of palette row 4.

Enjoy!

Edit: Replaced map16 E000 with E600.

versions.title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Coal Mine (Outside)
versions.filename: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Coal Mine - outside - good.zip

name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-psx-farm-day
title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Farm (Day)
description:
I did say I'll come back to the stage 1 BG of Sexy Parodius. This BG is seen in the day portion of the level.
Since this BG was long, I decided to rip as best I could. While it was a close to hard territory, I ripped it using Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting feature with near accurate results. You can edit the back area color or you an add the included HDMA effect.

No credit needed.

name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-psx-girl-factory-boss
title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Girl Factory (Boss)
description:
This BG is seen where you fight the Transporting Crane. Used Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting Feature and ripped the lights, the tile with the red triangle part and the pole with the mostly orange colors from scratch.

The lights are ExAnimated.
Uses the second half of palette 4.
BG uses a full Map16 page.

No credit needed.

name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-psx-sweet-sky
title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Sweet Sky
description:
Comes from stage 5 of the game where you fight Candy Core to advance. In the original, the rainbow was transparent and I don't have the asm knowledge to add it for the rainbow for this game, but perhaps someone with this knowledge might be able to leave a code that's compatible with the HDMA included in the archive.
The clouds were a great challenge for me to paste into Aseprite while looking good. Drew some new tiles for the clouds for proper loop. Use the Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting feature twice to rip this BG and removed most of the useless pixels near the vines for detail.

No credit needed.

Edit: Fixed small map16 bug.

name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-psx-taj-mahal
title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Taj Mahal

Here's the background from the last stage of the game where the player ship or ships pursue Takosuke as he stole all the loot as the previous missions were completed or otherwise. Used Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting feature and removed the green color as I did have trouble with the transparent color as it was spotted black in the tool.

Enjoy!

name: smwgraphics-snes-controller-buttons
title: SNES Controller Buttons
description:
Originally made and submitted (and rejected) on the Summer C3 of 2023. This submission was a suggestion / request by
Heitor Porfirio.
It has since been refined and greatly improved thanks to the feedback received.

This is a pack of graphic tiles for each and every button on a SNES / Super Famicom controller.
They're intended to be used in tutorial levels, or as general indicators of what input is expected from the player at any point in a level.

There are a few alternate designs for most buttons to suit different needs and preferences, including different colors and button formats.
There are also animated versions of all tiles to show the button being pressed.

The graphics use a handful of palette rows to accomodate for all different colors of buttons, but only uses the right side of them, so the only palettes overwritten are Pink Berry and Red Berry.
Depending on your needs, you may not use all palettes.

The included ReadMe file contains information on the usage of palettes, as well as the use of slots for ExAnimation, so it's worth checking out if you need to change these things for any reason (such as palette space, AN2 file space, ExAnimation slots...).

name: smwgraphics-somari-rings
title: Somari - Rings
description:
That's an update for the Somari Rings submission (firstly submitted by KaidenThelens and updated by Hammerer (me)).

This update includes some notable changes, like:

1. The gfx for the rings was modified, now it looks more like the Somari rings ripped.
2. Added the ring graphics in GFX01 (for the coin animation when hit blocks), something missed in the first submission, along with the ring palette in palette row A for the coin sprites (it replaces the last 3 color slots (AD, AE and AF))
NOTE: The tile EA is slighter than the GFX33 version, since it was necessary to reduce the tile size to fit in the 8x8 space.
3. The blue palette in row 7 is different now, with shades that match best with the original palette (in row 6).
4. There's now the option to modify also the coin tile used in status bar, replacing it with the ring miniature in Sumari's status bar. I've included two ways to do that:

Way 1 (still): Using the tile 2E included in the submission's GFX28;

Way 2 (animated): Using ExAnimation to replace the original tile 2E in GFX28 with an animation similar to the coin animation in Sumari's status bar.

For this, the submission includes a mwl file with the exanimation (it's in the level exanimation option - you can change it to the global exanimation option if you want without problems) and a ExGFX file to be inserted in AN2 slot (you can set the exanimation to use alternate ExGFX file instead of using AN2, name the file with 60-63 for it).
NOTE: It will also change the collected Dragon/Yoshi Coin graphics in the status bar, as SMW uses the same tile for both!
5. You may want to use Tweaker tool to change the palette row used by sprites 45 (directional coin) and 7E (flying coin) from 8 and C to A.
Description from the first version of the submission:

Rings from Somari. That's about it.

name: smwgraphics-sonic-mania-press-garden-zone-act
title: Sonic Mania - Press Garden Zone (Act 2 - Trees)
description:
This is both ripped and original. By original, I mean I drew some extra tiles, as I wasn't able to include every tile here. Besides, I might end up with more tiles. Also, I aimed for accuracy. I think I did well, but it's your decision. I did this according to Teyla's suggestion. This goes really well with Anorakun's Sonic Mania - Press Garden Zone rip.
Here's what you can do:

-full 512x512 BG - check;
-configurable BG for other users - check, but watch out.
-uses all palettes - check. I wanted to add more, but because of palette limitations, I went with my configuration and turned out well.
-SMW status bar compatibility - no. You must use either DKCR Sprite Status Bar or Remove Status Bar patches.
-tile consumption: 124 8x8 tiles. A very good BG choice.
-.mwl sample file - check;
-screenshot and in-game pic - irrelevant, but check.

Give credit, if used.

Recommended to use Lui37's "Move Layer 3 to subscreen fix" patch as well, unless you want your status bar to go behind layers 1 and 2. Or use a sprite status bar.

Uses BG1, ExAnimation and 2 rows of palettes ( the first half of the palette 0 and the palette 2).

This BG had game assisted tiles that stood in my way. I ripped the background using Lunar Magic bitmap pasting feature, since the BG uses more colors. name: smwgraphics-super-mario-all-stars-custom-forest
title: Super Mario All-Stars - Custom Forest
description:
This tileset was based in some stuff from Super Mario Maker 2 in Super Mario Bros. from NES mode, from some other tilesets.
Now, it was completely created in the Super Mario All-Stars style!

The Background and Layer 3 contains three other palette variants plus the default one, that means you have four options.

And the Foreground has only one palette variant plus the default one, resulting in two options.

NOTE: If you use the Layer 3, you still can use the vanilla status bar normally if your level doesn't have vertical scrolling, and along with the background obviously.
But it's most recommended that you use some alternate patch that modifies the status bar mechanics.

Here are some examples:
DKCR Styled Sprite Status Bar
New Super Mario Bros. Wii Styled Status Bar
Remove Status Bar
RAM Toggled Status Bar (& IRQ)

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-bros-deluxe-styled-overworld
title: Super Mario Bros. Deluxe Styled Overworld
description:
These are overworld graphics loosely based on the overworld graphics from Super Mario Bros. Deluxe for the GBC.

Caveats:
- These graphics are not compatible with the original SMW overworld graphics. If you want to use these, you'll have to (re)build your overworld from scratch.
- The waterfall animation is 15 FPS. SMW doesn't initialize overworld animations like it does with level animations, meaning overworld animations faster than 7.5 FPS mess up in-game. This is fixed in Lunar Magic 2.53, but if you're using an earlier version of Lunar Magic for whatever reason, there's a fix included that uses UberASM. Alternately, there's a version included that slows the waterfall down to half speed to sidestep this issue.
- The level tiles use multiple color palette animation. If you want to edit the animation, edit ExGFX 84 in a hex editor starting at offset FC4 at your peril. If you want to remove the animation, clear global exanimation slot 03.

versions.title: Super Mario Bros. Deluxe Styled Overworld

Small modifications to the graphics were made in the event that the changes were nearly unnoticeable to conserve palette space. They use palettes 2 and 3, along with the unused half of palette 4. I say "background" because it's actually part of the same foreground layer that Jonathan Jones stands on overlooking the sunset. I edited out the cliff graphics to save on palette space and also to focus on the sunset. Plus the cliff graphics would naturally be isometric, SMRPG after all, which would come off as odd in a SMW hack level. Uses a little of palette 1 and basically all of palette 3. Would recommend to have H-scroll BG setting set to either none or a custom slow setting.

title: Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars - Vista Hill
description:
Layer 3 Cloud Layer used in Vista Hill where Mario overlooks Bowser's Keep from afar. Highly recommend using one of the following patches to avoid having the background being cutoff:
edit1754's Sprite Status Bar, WhiteYoshiEgg's DKCR Styled Sprite Status Bar, Ladida's SMB3 and Minimalist Status Bars or (alternatively) Lui37's Remove Status Bar.

Update: Now includes the daytime palette used in the credits sequence.

Moderator's note: by setting Initial Y Position to 0B0 in the Layer 3 Settings to lower the background vertically, I managed to make it not get cutoff by the status bar. If you want to place it higher, then you can use one of the patches mentioned above to circumvent the cutoff issue.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-2-yoshi-s-island-layer
title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Layer 3 Water
description:
The layer 3 water used in Yoshi's Island, mainly seen in the level 4-6. Uses 4 animation slots.

Keep in mind that, due to SMW physics, the water will move you, unlike in Yoshi's Island, where it doesn't. For this, there is an hex edit included to make the layer 3 tides don't move Mario (keep in mind this is a global change). Alternatively you can make this water to have auto-scroll like in SMW, but due to the style of the animation it doesn't fit too well.

versions.title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Layer 3 Water

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-2-yoshi-s-island-title-screen-world
title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Title Screen (World 6)
description:
The 2bpp background of the title screen / castle destruction cutscene of Yoshi's Island when you have reached world 6, converted into a 64x64 tilemap made out of 8x8 tiles and otherwise taken straight out of the game.

Note that in order to display this background properly, a custom status bar is recommend.
That being said, with some HDMA to cover the cutoff, you also are able to also use a vanilla Status Bar since the background is located at the bottom half of the tilemap.

versions.title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Title Screen (World 6)

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-angled-water-and-munchers

Inspired by people saying that upside-down water is unrealistic, I made slanted water just for kicks. Muncher graphics for all orthogonal and diagonal directions are thrown in too.

Give credit please, as all but sideways munchers are handdrawn by myself.

This is to be inserted over the original goalpost, which uses palettes 4 and 7.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-beta
title: Super Mario World Beta
description:
Super Mario World Beta GFX! Updated Version, I Know From This Is A Lost Byte Again! Please Remind That Is A Beta SMW File.

Mirann edit: May not be sufficiently accurate beta GFX.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-beta-cage-mockup
title: Super Mario World - Beta Cage (Mockup)
description:
At long last, the famous beta cage mockup from TCRF is finally here to the public, right where it belongs! Credit to BMF (a.k.a. Rachel Mae) for the original mockup! Unfortunately, the actual .bin file for the graphics wasn't shared, so I had to manually draw every tile accurately from the screenshot. Included is a patch that allows you to remap the sprite tiles used by the wings. It also features the basic ability to manually remap the tiles used by the cage in case you don't want to use the provided LT4 file for some reason. The provided LG4 file can either be used per-level or globally replace 'GFX2B.bin', but be aware that the 'Nintendo' and 'SUPER MARIO BROS. 4' text are overwritten. Lastly, the provided SP2 file contains a slightly modified version of the prototype wings that overwrites the Yoshi berry. Enjoy!

No More Sprite Tiles Limit v1.2.1. is needed for all the wings to display properly.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-beta-hack-mario-raccoon
title: Super Mario World Beta (Hack) - Mario (Raccoon)
description:
This will turn Mario into the Small Beta Raccoon Mario from the Super Mario World Beta hack.

Credit goes to YoshiMaster.

Only changes Small Mario. Has no effect on big Mario.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-beta-hack-yoshi-coin
title: Super Mario World Beta (Hack) - Yoshi Coin
description:
The Yoshi Coins seen in Yoshi Master's beta remake hack.


Well, Enjoy i guess.

Sample level added for the heck of it.

versions.title: Super Mario World Beta (Hack) - Yoshi Coin

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-beta-styled-bros-and-giant-enemies
title: Super Mario World (Beta) Styled Bros. and Giant Enemies
description:
Custom graphics for the generic Bro. enemies that come with Romi's Sprite Tool 1.41 and Nameless Protagonist's Fire/Ice Bro pack. It comes with:

-SMW pre-release styled graphics for the Hammer / Boomerang / Fire / Ice Bros. Due to the graphics for these being unfinished, I took some liberties regarding how they would have looked had they stayed in the final game.

-SMW styled graphics for the Hammer / Boomerang / Fire / Ice Bros. Mostly based on the Super Mario Maker Hammer Bro. graphics.

-SMW pre-release Sledge Bro. It's slighly more detailed than the original, and it comes with Custom Giant Goomba and Spiny graphics (those were in the .bin file alongside the giant bro. so I thought "why not?").

Note that the Hammer and Boomerang Bros. use palettes D and B in the screenshots, so you'll need to edit their .cfg files if you want them green and blue respectively.

versions.title: Super Mario World (Beta) Styled Bros. and Giant Enemies

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-beta-styled-venus-fire-trap
title: Super Mario World (Beta) Styled Venus Fire Trap
description: Venus Fire Trap from the Beta of Super Mario World, although i edited the shades to look more like the piranha plants from the final game. There are 2 versions: one with the open mouth, and one that seems to be blowing the fire.

versions.title: Super Mario World (Beta) Styled Venus Fire Trap

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-better-player-extensions
title: Super Mario World - Better Player Extensions
description:
This graphic enhances the arms of Mario and Luigi, these extension graphics also support Fire Mario, Luigi and Fire Luigi palettes. Credits are not required.

Note: This extension supports Luigi's All-Stars graphics as well.

versions.title: Super Mario World - Better Player Extensions

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-bloody-font
title: Super Mario World - Bloody Font
description:
A version of the basegame SMW font but edited to be distressed, melty and bloody. Meant to be used for creepy, unsettling settings. Inspired by Damien Guard's Blood Rain font.

Includes a palette for another variant if you really want to have the text be truly blood-colored.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-bonus
title: Super Mario World - Bonus
description:
All of the original bonus background, now in Layer 3.
Requested by TheAbusefreakhacker0.

mod note: as the original status bar will cut fullscreen layer 3 backgrounds off, you may want to use a status bar patch (e.g. Sprite Status Bar)

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-boomerang-hammer-bros
title: Super Mario World - Boomerang/Hammer Bros.
description:
This is my attempt at drawing more SMW-style graphics for the Hammer and Boomerang Bros. included with Romi's SpriteTool. There's even a custom palette/palmask for NamelessProtagonist's Ice Bros.

Edit: Fixed up the proportions a bit.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-bushes-layer
title: Super Mario World - Bushes (Layer 3)
description: A neat addition to every Vanilla flavoured Hack to spice up your grassland or forest levels. It doesn't contain berries sadly but I hope it still is going to be of use for some people. Also credit would be nice.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-castle
title: Super Mario World - Castle
description:
Don't need Credit me. But, credit is thanks.
You need Sprite Status Bar Patch

※ Do not use a candle sprite on a pillar. It moves along Layer 2.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-castle-blocks
title: Super Mario World - Castle Blocks
description:
We should take a background and push it somewhere else make it more awesome! This castle blocks background from Super Mario World has got some parallax scrolling added with the use of layer 3 and HDMA. Make sure you read the readme! HDMA Parallax Toolkit is needed .

Use it with a custom status bar, like DKCR status bar.

No credits required!

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-castle-extended
title: Super Mario World - Castle (Extended)
description:
The vanilla Super Mario World castle tile set but extended to be compatible with other vanilla ground objects, such as slopes, ledges and still water.

This can be used as a drop-in replacement for other FG3 tile sets (such as 1A in underground levels, etc) but is still compatible with vanilla castle background and stone objects.

Uses vanilla palettes and includes an optional map16 file for castle spikes, large stones and the big boss door with a bonus door handle variation (as shown the sample level).

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-castle-pillars
title: Super Mario World - Castle Pillars
description:
With this, you can have parallax scrolling in your castle levels! The castle pillars in the back are now in layer 3. You will have to edit layer 2 a bit to get this looking nice if you want it to look like the original, though.
Credit is not necessary, but I'd like it :)
Released in C3 Winter 2016.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-cave
title: Super Mario World - Cave
description:
Now caves have a new layer! Just apply everything in the file and it should work.

mod note: as the original status bar will cut fullscreen layer 3 backgrounds off, you may want to use a status bar patch (e.g. Sprite Status Bar)

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-cave-water
title: Super Mario World - Cave Water
description:
A layer 3 variant of the water seen in cave levels In SMW. You can set it to act like tides or something else.
(Note in order to not have Mario be pushed by a current you may have to use a hex edit. Also note that you may have to mess around with the “Initial Y Position” values which can be found in the layer 3 settings)

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-chocolate-island
title: Super Mario World - Chocolate Island
description:
With this, you can make your SMW-like mountain levels nicer looking! All of the original mountain background in Chocolate Island from SMW, now in layer 3.
Credit is not necessary, but I'd like it :)
Released in C3 Winter 2016.

Skewer Edit: You may want to use a sprite status bar patch with this one.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-clouds
title: Super Mario World - Clouds
description:
Now compatible with LM2.30+

This is a Layer 3 version of the cloud background seen in some levels in SMW (such as Cheese Bridge Area). It uses few enough colors that very little was lost in the 4bpp -> 2bpp transition; the only thing different about it is that the oval clouds no longer have eyes.
allowiscous' custom tilemap and palette also included.

mod note: as the original status bar will cut fullscreen layer 3 backgrounds off, you may want to use a status bar patch (e.g. Sprite Status Bar)

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-cutscene-ground
title: Super Mario World - Cutscene Ground
description:
A rip of the ground tiles used in the castle destruction cutscenes (with newly created corner and side tiles). Can be used as flowery grass or sand/stone depending on the palette.

Doesn't interfere with the normal grassland ledges and slopes. The included map 16 uses vanilla palette lines 5 and 6, but it works with various palettes. Replaces FG3.

There are three versions included:
-One that replaces the "bush 3" tiles
-One that replaces the "skinny horizontal pipe" tiles
-One that replaces the "skinny vertical pipe" tiles

Credit not necessary but appreciated of course.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-enhanced
title: Super Mario World Enhanced
description:
This is an ExGFX entirely modifed with Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. series graphics, mainly focusing on Super Mario Bros. 3 style and some Yoshi's Island (only a few) background graphics.

Rips made by Pac, have fun using them!

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-enhanced-luigi
title: Super Mario World Enhanced Luigi
description:
The hit sequel to this sheet.

Ideal if you want to use a different player graphic instead of a lazy recolor or if you don't like the All-Stars Luigi.

Best used with this patch.
Includes a GFX28 file, overworld palette and shared palette file in case you want Luigi to be player 1 of your hack.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-enhanced-mario
title: Super Mario World Enhanced Mario
description:
A complete upgrade to the original game's Mario. Ripped from this sheet.

Best used with this patch.
No custom palette needed.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-extended-orange-rocks
title: Super Mario World - Extended Orange Rocks
description:
Extended version of the orange rocks seen in Ludwig's Castle, No custom palette is required

Credit isn't necessary but appreciated.

Requested By Blizzard Buffalo

versions.title: Super Mario World - Extended Orange Rocks

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-faceless-mario
title: Super Mario World - Faceless Mario
description:
Super Mario World Mario (...and Luigi) GFX, just missing one minor thing; a face.

-Includes Overworld frames

-No palette editing necessary (Uses standard SMW palette)

-Does not act out Post-Castle cutscenes (Feel free to request)

-Great for those who love Mario, but hate his face

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-forest
title: Super Mario World - Forest
description:
With this, you can make your SMW-like forest levels nicer looking! All of the original forest background, now in layer 3.

This can be used as a drop-in replacement for other FG3 tile sets, such as 15 in normal theme levels, etc.

Uses vanilla palettes and includes a map16 file for re-mapped forest assets: small and wide tree trunks (with branches), the overhead leaves, and grass tufts (as shown in the sample level).

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-improved-mario
title: Super Mario World - Improved Mario
description:
These graphics are heavily based on the original and are meant to fix sloppiness and errors. I have done my best to get rid of coloring inconsistencies, sloppy drawing, weird posing, and anything ugly in general while still looking vanilla. There are also alternate options to add shading to Mario's shoes or gloves (or both)! The graphics work well in other palettes too.

Contents of the zip:
-GFX00.bin*4
-GFX32.bin*4 (four versions for each of the options mentioned above)
-GFX22.bin (sorted only with the options it's needed for)
-A shared palette for the overworld
-And a readme with in-depth installation instructions as well as example.png which the readme refers to.


I hope you all enjoy this and make good use of it, I've been working on this for well over a year now! Lots of tiny changes that added up and I even restarted from scratch at one point. Maybe Luigi is next...

...Credit ain't necessary but I would really appreciate it :3

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-japan-title-screen
title: Super Mario World (Japan) - Title Screen
description:
Title Screen and Misc. Layer 3 Objects present in the Japanese Version of SMW. Credit would be appreciated, it was a pain to get these tiles ripped and merged without overwriting the US's english characters.

Note: These Graphics are almost straight from the JP version of the game, you have to rearrange the tiles yourself or use the included .bps file to fix the issue.

This changes:
-The big "SUPER MARIO WORLD" font (duh)
-The Copyright symbol (c)
-The wood borders
-Adds the JP version's ™ symbol (you can still use the US one too)

Hope you enjoy!

Moderator's Note : the set up for the title screen is in the patch provided; there is no known way to export a title screen to a seperate file except by use of an outdated tool. With this is in mind... accepted.

For your reference, the default title screen is more or less identical to that of the Japanese release.

To see anything of the level, simply disable layer 3 in Lunar Magic (press 3 on the keyboard).

UPDATE 2: I fixed some missing pixels, fixed a few frames and other minor fixes.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-pal-v-1
title: Super Mario World (PAL V.1.1) - Castle Grass
description:
The PAL V.1.1 version of Super Mario World changes the way grass tiles look during castle entrance cutscene to compensate for the increased vertical resolution. If you want a more detailed explanation about it, you can check this post by Retro Game Mechanics Explained. You can now fill your castle levels with grass tiles without it looking wrong and without any additional graphics.

First screenshot shows how the new grass tiles look, and the second shows how the original grass looks like for comparison.

Credit is unecessary.

Murphmario's Update: Added two map16 files to make this more accurate to the original graphics. The first one will apply it to the vanilla tile (make sure the fg/bg gfx index is set to Castle 1) while the "separate" one will add in a new tile on page 5.

description:
This is the font used on the pre-credits scene (when you rescue Peach) that bears a striking resemblance to the classic NES font used in games like SMB1. The font in the final game doesn't contain all uppercase letters (since it doesn't need to), but a full font set (that perfectly matches up with the message box font, no less!) was found among the many other early smw graphics in the 2020 gigaleak. Perhaps this was the original English message font?
Nevetheless, it's still a pretty nice font, so now you can use it in your romhacks if you so please!

The ILLUSIYELLOW text is unchanged. The numbers have been replaced by those from the SMB1 font as no equivalent exists in the leaked font afaik.
For convenience's sake, the leftover Japanese question/exclamation marks have been replaced by an 8 and 9.

No credit needed!
