name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-pre-release-mushroom
title: Super Mario World (Pre-release) - Mushroom
description:
Earlier version of the underground layer 3 background found on the development files of Super Mario World, which included mushrooms.
Original tilemap/graphics were in 4bpp, color reduction and further paletting were done by Heraga.

Can be used fine with vanilla status bar if used without too much scrolling, otherwise an asm workaround (or editing the tilemap a bit) can be used.

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-pre-release-overworld
title: Super Mario World (Pre-release) - Overworld
description:
The earliest overworld graphics known to exist from Super Mario World development days, which only give Super Mario Bros. 3 vibes. The patch provided includes a recreation of the leaked map (with a few sample events) and a simple demo submap.

Originally released during Summer 2022 C3, but now with a few more tweaks like: alternative shapes for some objects to prevent cutoff and vertical bridge.

Doesn't require to disable event path fade effect (Lunar Magic option), but personally I recommend to use it because the effect looks weird with graphics like this (you probably will have to disable it anyway if you use other overworld ExGFX).

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-pre-release-piranha-plant
title: Super Mario World (Pre-release) - Piranha Plant
description:

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-redrawn
title: Super Mario World Redrawn
description:
Icegoom's original description: "I've played a lot of SMW hacks. Many of them have really cool graphical changes. But one thing that always bugged me was that no matter how extensive the changes were elsewhere, there were always a certain amount of old SMW sprites left over. You can't rip climbing Koopas, Urchins, Fishin' Boo, or Bowser's Clown Car from other games. So I set out to redraw every single sprite in the game in a Gameboy Advance/Nintendo DS style. Along the way, I also started doing foreground objects.

Basically, this hack is here for anyone starting work on a Super Mario World hack who wants a complete and stylistically consistent spriteset. The sprites themselves are basically done, although I'll tweak them quite a bit for the next release. The foregrounds are in an incomplete state, and I haven't even started replacing the backgrounds yet. The overworld's had extensive work done on it, but there are a lot of screwed up palettes I haven't bothered to fix yet.

Anyhoo, these sprites are here for whoever wants them. Completely open source, no credit necessary. Just focus on making some fun Super Mario World hacks, guys."

It's had some modifications from the version hosted in hacks section, some things might be different as the overworld, palettes of some sprites, so you'll have to fix some things yourself with Overworld Editor and with external tools as Tweaker as for some sprites.

It also includes a folder with alternate redrawn graphics in case you feel like trying different versions of graphics icegoom has made before. With this said, hope you enjoy it!

name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-glass-pipes
title: Super Mario World Styled Glass Pipes
description:
Glass version of the vanilla SMW pipes. The first type uses a lighter blue color and is completely solid. All tiles are available so you can use decorative pipes and exit enabled pipes. The second type uses a darker blue color and is priority enabled and non-solid. You will need to place solid blocks around these to prevent the player from falling through. The best application is to use them in the ground with solid tiles around them that use the same graphic as the rest of the ground around them. The passthrough pipes have been modified to create a better visual effect preventing the 1 pixel line of transparency on the sides.

For an even better visual effect, use a background that has a sky in the top and underground theme on the bottom (such as the underground bg from SMAS SMB3), and set the Layer 2 scrolling to H:Variable, V:Constant. Adjust the height of the background so the sky starts where the ground of the level is going to be, to prevent sky from showing through the transparent underground pipes.

description:

Important Notes:

1. You must need to change the sprite (orbinaut.json and orbinaut_spike_ball.json) for another palette row using CFG Editor, a program included in PIXI files.

The sprite is intended to feature a blue color, so you would need to change it for palette row B, but you can as well change it for another sprite palette row that would fit good with the sprite, as row A (yellow), row C (red) and row D (green).

Don't forget you need to change the palette row for both sprites included, orbinaut.json and orbinaut_spike_ball.json, but if you want you can set different color for head and spike balls sprites (for example, making the orbinaut head gets green and the spike balls get red).

Collapse Text
Code
init:
    LDA #$04
    STA $0D9D|!addr
    STA $212C
    STA $212E
    LDA #$13
    STA $0D9E|!addr
    STA $212D

Features include chocolate blocks, peppermint poles, (an attempt at) rock-candy semisolids, decorative donuts and lollipops, and candy bridges with licorice railings. Too bad you're walking all over it!

name: smwgraphics-taiketsu-ultra-hero-gba-clouds
title: Taiketsu! Ultra Hero (GBA) - Clouds
description:
Hi. I'm here with another BG from a game I never heard of in my life. It's called 'Taiketsu! Ultra Hero ' for the GBA. The word 'Taiketsu' means 'Showdown'. The BG was used in The City stage. Originally, this BG was ripped by Omega, the one from Spriters Resource. I converted it to SMW usage by using the Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting Feature. The best thing is that the palette is very easy to edit and the back area color is used, too. I had to fix the BG a bit with no trouble at all. Because this BG comes from a fighting game, it's recommended to set both Vertical and Horizontal scrolling of the BG to None.
Omega85 deserves the credit. I only did my job. Enjoy!

name: smwgraphics-taiketsu-ultra-hero-gba-ice-mountain-clouds
title: Taiketsu! Ultra Hero (GBA) - Ice Mountain Clouds
description:
Here's another BG from 'Taiketsu! Ultra Hero ' for the GBA. This was ripped by Omega85 and converted by me for SMW usage using the Lunar Magic Bitmsap Pasting feature. BE is used for the Ice Mountains stage. This had the Touhou-like formula. I actually had to edit the BG, as the original version surpassed the 4 GFX limit. You can use the Goal Tape, Midway Bar, Doors, Star Blocks and 3-up Moons and that's it. Because of the BG structure, either the top, bottom or both parts must be covered. In the screenshot, you see the BG being covered by the bottom part. Because this BG comes from a fighting game, it's recommended to set both Vertical and Horizontal scrolling of the BG to None.
Omega85 deserves the credit.
Hope it's useful.

versions.title: Taiketsu! Ultra Hero (GBA) - Ice Mountain Clouds
versions.filename: Taiketsu%21 Ultra Hero(GBA) - Ice Mountain Clouds.zip

name: smwgraphics-taiketsu-ultra-hero-gba-mountain-clouds
title: Taiketsu! Ultra Hero (GBA) - Mountain Clouds
description:
Hey there. This BG was ripped by Omega85 and converted by me for SMW usage using the Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting feature. Originally, this BG was ready as it is, but I decided to remove some tiles while making the BG as detailed as possible. The background uses less than 1 palette and thanks to the GFX edits, the Triangle Blocks, Star Blocks, Arrow Signs + Grass, Bullet Bill Blasters, 3-up Moons, Goal Posts, Doors, Vines, Midway Tapes and Transluscent Blocks can now be used. Set Vertical and Horizontal scrolliing settings for BG to None.
Omega85 deserves the credit. I converted the BG for SMW usage.

Since the BG is from a fighting game, the Vertical and Horizontal setting for the BG must be set to None and also, set the BG like in the first screenshot.

name: smwgraphics-tb-the-blue-guy
title: TB the Blue Guy
description:
Who is TB? TB is true blue, terrifically bold in the face of danger, and might just be the best. Requested by, and Minecraft skin (and original character?) of, MarioIsTheBest1234. There are some extra palettes to help TB work in your own context.

Contents
Graphics files:
GFX00 (required)
GFX10 (overworld sprite)
GFX22 and GFX24 (only needed vs vanilla Bowser)
GFX28 (status bar)
GFX32 (required)

Asar patches:
fixes.asm (contains a few necessary hex edits)

6 player palettes (shared SMWPAL for the player, and custom PAL with PALMASKs for the overworld)

Readme will guide you on specific changes, important links, and a description of each palette.

A Background and Tile set from "Devious Four Chronicles #3: The Crater" by "antimatterhunter" and "Scorpion". This is just your regular everyday grassland tile set. Unfortunately, I wasn't thinking, and I made this a 16x16 Foreground, when it could've easily fit the description of Standard Object placement. Oh well, just enjoy this tile set please.

Please give credit if used, thanks!

name: smwgraphics-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-tournament-fighters-genesis-ancient-planet
title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters (Genesis) - Ancient Planet
description:
This was first ripped by Yawackhary. I converted this for SMW usage. The downside is that you won't be able to use bushes and slanted pipes. The Ice Planet was also first ripped by Belial. I did the same thing there. About the Ancient Planet tileset: you can use this for battling in an ancient dinosaur land. This does feature the following:

-the BG and FG are included and the design is just like how it's supposed to. If you do remove the dinosaur for the BG, then it can fit into a nice forest BG.
-the BG uses 78 tiles, but the FG is the real kicker, as that uses 312 tiles, but fortunately, there's the sample level with the BG and FG fully inserted.
-oddly enough, the BG and FG use the same palette.

Give credit to Yawackhary. Also, give credit to Belial if you use the Ice Planet set.
Also, not sure what tag goes here, besides ancient.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters (Genesis) - Bio Planet
description:
Tileset was ripped by Belial. I converted it for SMW usage. I mirrored it for efficiency and tile reduction.

This does have some advantages:

-The BG consumes half of palette 1 and the FG consumes half of palette 4 and both palettes are organised. The SMW status colors aren't affected.
-The BG uses 33 tiles, making this a short one. The FG uses a full Map16 page. Check the sample file to see the setup.
-The BG's colors are animated. I did this quite well.

Credit Belial for the tileset.

name: smwgraphics-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-tournament-fighters-genesis-spaceship
title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters (Genesis) - Spaceship
description:
Here it is: the last tileset of the game. A fight on a spaceship. Belial ripped this. I did convert it to SMW usage. It does have the following features:

-this tileset does consume BG1, FG3, BG2, BG3 and FG2 tiles. Only the bushes, slanted pipes and gradient colors have been removed, but the rest is there.
-the FG has 170 Map16 tiles and the BG has 194 Map16 tiles.
-Bonus: BG and FG use the same palette.
-Bonus: In case you want to use the BG or FG of this tileset, you can use ExGFX files included here.

versions.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters (Genesis) - Spaceship

name: smwgraphics-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-tournament-fighters-snes-back-alley
title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters (SNES) - Back Alley
description:
Tileset was ripped from the game.

-if you just want to use the BG and that's it, then insert ExGFX37B.bin into your hack, the Map16 file and palette, check the sample file and you're good to go.
-the palettes can be edited, although you have to experiment.
-tileset uses 5 palettes. While that's a lot, you can use this for a boss battle or where you need to kill enemies to advance.
-a palette is used by both the BG and FG.
-BG only uses 61 8x8 tiles and 32 Map16 tiles. It's quite easy. The FG does use 280 Map16 tiles. About the 8x8 tiles, the total for FG is 503 tiles.
-tileset uses some FG2, BG1, FG3, BG2 and BG3 tiles, sparing room for FG1 and FG3.
-no people included, although they take more tiles than needed.

versions.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tournament Fighters (SNES) - Back Alley

name: smwgraphics-temple-ruins

description: Made for C3 summer 2020, this stony tileset features both stone blocks and brick flooring, a variety of pillar tiles, everyone's favorite stone temple heads, and a pinch of overgrowth, just to add even a little color variation. The vines are climbable, but the floor tiles with vines attached only behave like platforms - if you want added vine functionality, you'll need custom blocks.

name: smwgraphics-terebi-denwa-super-mario-world-house

Ideal for interior home levels.

name: smwgraphics-terminator-genesis-tech-noir
title: Terminator (Genesis) - Tech Noir
description: The Tech Noir section area from the Terminator Mega Drive game.

name: smwgraphics-terranigma-beruga-s-tower
title: Terranigma - Beruga's Tower
description:
The background seen in various sections of the final dungeon, from Terranigma. My version uses one less tile, has better map 16 and optimizations in general. I didn't rip the color animation from the original because it uses very complex palette rotation. A great fit for factory levels, in general.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.

name: smwgraphics-terranigma-earth-s-essence
title: Terranigma - Earth's Essence
description:
The background seen at the end of each tower of the Underworld, from Terranigma. In this first chapter, Ark revives the land by beating five towers and gaining access to the "Earth's Essence". In the background, it is possible to see some Zodiac signs constellations. A good fit for space levels.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.

name: smwgraphics-terranigma-grecliff
title: Terranigma - Grecliff
description:
A mountain background seen in the some parts of the game, but mainly, Grecliff, one of the game's dungeons. Compared to the old version, it is much more optimized in map 16 and tiles. It also has better palette row and the original game gradient, which is meant to be inserted with UberASM Tool. A good fit for mountain levels.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.

name: smwgraphics-terranigma-hitoderon-gossie
title: Terranigma - Hitoderon & Gossie
description:
A complete rip of the background used in the battle of Hitoderon and Gossie, from Terranigma. Unlike the older version in the site, this one is the full background, no clever edits at all. This rip was part of my C3 Graphic Ripping Showcase .

(05/20/2022) MASSIVE UPDATE: Palette has been optimized. Better map 16. Optimized to use even less 8x8 tiles. Created some map 16 tiles for better looping.

Credit would be great, but is optional.

name: smwgraphics-terranigma-lhasa
title: Terranigma - Lhasa
description:
A mountain background seen in Lhasa, from Terranigma. Compared to the older version, this one uses a few more tiles, but has much more optimized map 16, better palette organization and it is extracted directly from an in-game tilemap. The background does not scroll, like in the original game. A good fit for mountain levels.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.

name: smwgraphics-terranigma-revival-of-humans
title: Terranigma - Revival of Humans
description:
The background seen in a few cutscenes of Terranigma, most notably when the humans are revived and when the Elder appears in one of Ark's dreams.

A good fit for pyramids or some ominous cutscenes, maybe.

Credit would be nice.

name: smwgraphics-terranigma-sky-ring
title: Terranigma - Sky Ring
description:
The sinister looking background from Terranigma, that appears when the player uses the Sky Ring to attack enemies. It is a very menacing sky background, that has a lot of red, which means it could make a great fit for an abstract or haunted level.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.

name: smwgraphics-terranigma-underworld-tower-exterior
title: Terranigma - Underworld Tower (Exterior)
description:
The mysterious and otherwordly crystals seen in the exterior side of the Underworld Towers, from Terranigma. This version includes an asm made by Donut which replicates the dark gradient applied in the background of the original game. It should be inserted using the UberASM Tool.

A good fit for crystal caves or otherwordly levels.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.

name: smwgraphics-terranigma-water-pin
title: Terranigma - Water Pin
description: The background seen when the player uses the Water Pin, ripped from Terranigma. Mermaids are not included,  because they are on a separate layer and I didn't want to put something in the zip file that would have a niche usage. A good fit for some abstract or weird levels, in general. Uses only 10 tiles, meaning it can be easily combined with other graphics.

name: smwgraphics-terraria-dead-corruption-trees
title: Terraria - Dead Corruption Trees

description:
The brick, stone, and spike tiles that were made for the HackJam adventure "Mario and Friends in: The Ghost's Gallery", now refined, expanded, and made compatible with some of SMW's vanilla palettes.

The "outline-only" style of the brick or stone walls is optional, you can use the traditional fully-lit ones instead if you wish.

Some ground tiles are duplicated for use as slope assist tiles or ledges, if you want to do fancy arrangements with slopes. Check the Act As or Tile Surface Outline view to see what's up.

The cracked block doesn't do anything special on its own, so insert whatever behavior for it you see fit.

This tileset is a single self-contained GFX file that can be combined with any of the vanilla tilesets, if you're looking to create combinations like outdoor courtyards.

name: smwgraphics-the-legend-of-the-mystical-ninja-horo-temple
title: The Legend of the Mystical Ninja - Horo Temple
description:
A complete (almost) rip of the first stage from Ganbare Goemon : Yuuki Hime Kyuushitsu Esaki, lit. "The Rescue of Princess Yuki", or The Legend of the Mystical Ninja.

Unlike the old rip in this site, who had a messy map 16 and a worse sample level, almost everything here was ripped manually, with the exception of the tree and the ruined walls, because in those I used the bitmap pasting feature, and then I rearranged the tiles manually in Lunar Magic. This rip took me two days to get it right. Perfect fit for haunted levels, since in the original game, it's used in a level with flaming ghosts, flying umbrellas, skeleton warriors and zombies.

WHAT IS INCLUDED IN THIS RIP:

- Main ground;
- Ruined walls;
- Bamboo;
- Bamboo Spikes;
- Tombstones;
- Trees;
- Grass;
- Logs;
- A "Shrine" of sorts. I also included the bell from the original game;
- Lanterns;

WHAT IS NOT INCLUDED:

-ExAnimation. I couldn't figure out a way of making it look good in Super Mario World;
- Some gravestones, logs and grass tiles;

Credit would be great, but is optional.

name: smwgraphics-the-legend-of-zelda-oracle-of-ages-seasons-overworld
title: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Ages & Seasons - Overworld
description:
I've always thought the graphics of the overworld from the Legend of Zelda games on the Game Boy would make for a great replacement set of graphics for the overworld in Super Mario World, so here it is.

This is a pretty comprehensive tile set as I took a great deal of effort to get as wide and varied a selection of tiles from the source games into this resource as I felt feasible, to enable many possibilities for terrain style. Additionally, some improvements were made over the originals regarding palettes and tile overlap details since there are fewer technical limitations.

The sample overworld I've included is relatively basic (there's no events, for example) and just throws down some ideas for map areas, but I feel there is a great deal of potential in this set and I look forward to seeing the overworlds people create with this.

title: Tom and Jerry - Factory
description:
BG used in the Level 1-2 in "Tom & Jerry" (SNES). Ideal for these factory levels.

Please give credit, if used.

name: smwgraphics-tom-and-jerry-house
title: Tom and Jerry - House
description: Background used in the house level in Tom and Jerry (SNES). Comes in both Layer 2 and Layer 3 format, being both of them identical, so you can use whatever you want (keep in mind though, that you would need the Sprite Status Bar patch if you use the Layer 3 one).

name: smwgraphics-tom-and-jerry-kitchen
title: Tom and Jerry - Kitchen
description:
Kitchen BG used in the world 4 of "Tom & Jerry" (SNES).

Give Credit if Used.

name: smwgraphics-tom-and-jerry-snes-the-marquee
title: Tom and Jerry (SNES) - The Marquee
description: Background and Foreground of the Level 1-1 (The Marquee) in Tom and Jerry for the SNES.

name: smwgraphics-tom-and-jerry-toys
title: Tom and Jerry - Toys
description:
Background and Foreground of the toys' level in Tom and Jerry (SNES).

Background is kinda huge, uses almost 4 full palette rows, and BG1, BG2 and BG3. Foreground is a bit lighter, uses 2 and a half palette rows and only FG3. Vanilla palette 6 and Status Bar palette are intact as well.

For a better use of the large cheese and 1UP, use custom blocks.

name: smwgraphics-tom-jerry-jerry
title: Tom & Jerry - Jerry
description:
Jerry Mouse from the Tom and Jerry cartoons.

Includes overworld, cape, riding on Yoshi, P-Balloon and cutscene frames, but doesn't include running on wall frames, because I'm unable to make the cape correctly aligned with these frames.

NOTE 1: Player 2's colors are slightly brighter than Player 1's.
NOTE 2: The OW palette isn't a shared palette, you must import it on all submaps and the main map or Jerry will look like a silhouette!

You must use this patch to fix the victory pose when you're small while riding Yoshi if you're using him in your hack, the included "Hex Edits.asm" if you want the START messages (which requires the use of the included GFX0F.bin to fix the Y), to change Mario's name to Jerry when selecting or erasing a save file in the title screen, and to change the lives exchanger text when playing with 2 players.

Edit: Antennas were missing from the overworld frames.
Edit 2: Fixed leg in one of the walking while big frames.

name: smwgraphics-tombstone-thwomp
title: Tombstone Thwomp
description:
A thwomp shaped like a tombstone for graveyard/ghost house levels. Instead of angry faces, it has an epitaph that says "DIE" or "RIP" for its proximity and falling phases, respectively.

Uses the same GFX tiles and palette as vanilla Thwomps.

name: smwgraphics-tony-hawk-s-underground
title: Tony Hawk's UnderGround 2 GBA - Fonts
description: This font is for Text Boxes, Level Names, and Title Screen from Tony Hawk's UnderGround 2.

name: smwgraphics-tony-hawk-s-underground-gba-fonts
title: Tony Hawk's UnderGround GBA - Fonts
description: This font is for Text Boxes, Level Names, and Title Screen from Tony Hawk's UnderGround.

name: smwgraphics-toothy
title: Toothy
description: An SMW-styled version of Toothy from Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story.

name: smwgraphics-top-fighter
title: Top Fighter 2000 MK VIII - Cycl's Stage
description:
Background used in the Cycl's stage in the bootleg game Top Fighter 2000 MK VIII, for the Sega Genesis.

Note that, the background is originally 24x14, which even fitting all gameplay's screen, it's kinda limited, therefore I added two modified versions (with their respective sample level) to use: one with a horizontal looping setting and one with fully vertically expanded waterfalls, so you can use the one you like more (all versions uses the same map16). I also made the animation smooth, unlike in the original game.

versions.title: Top Fighter 2000 MK VIII - Cycl's Stage

name: smwgraphics-top-gear
title: Top Gear 3000 - Title Screen Font
description:
The font used on the title screen of Top Gear 3000 (SNES)

I included two versions, one for cutscenes and other for global replacement in GFX2A (white-colored)

name: smwgraphics-top-gear-menu-font
title: Top Gear - Menu Font
description: The font used in the menus in Top Gear (SNES)

title: Top Gun: The Second Mission - Font
description: Ripped for font with custom small letters from Top Gun and Top Gun: The Second Mission for NES, it was released in 1987, and then later released for a sequel in 1990 by Konami and Paramount Pictures Corporation.

versions.title: Top Gun: The Second Mission - Font
versions.filename: Top Gun and Top Gun - The Second Mission - Font.zip

name: smwgraphics-torpedo-galoomba
title: Torpedo Galoomba
description: A Torpedo Ted that looks suspiciously like a Galoomba. Or is it a Galoomba that looks suspiciously like a Torpedo Ted?

name: smwgraphics-torpedo-ted-styled-bullet-bill
title: Torpedo Ted Styled Bullet Bill
description: Replaces the Bullet Bill with a smaller version of the Torpedo Ted, as requested by FireYoshi. Also comes with vertical and diagonal variants for the rope sprite tileset! Insert these either as ExGFX or over GFX01 (standard) and GFX05 (vertical and diagonal) in case you want those graphics to be global in your hack. Credit not needed but would be appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-totem-barrel-beach
title: Totem Barrel Beach
description: This graphic was a request from a friend, a beach gfx with totems and some barrels, now you can use this for you levels.

name: smwgraphics-touhou-adventures-of-reimu
title: Touhou: Adventures of Reimu 2 - Cirno
description:
Here's GFX of everyone's favorite strongest fairy from Touhou series, Cirno as a boss.

Ripped from Touhou: Adventures of Reimu 2
Edited slightly show the feet and wings properly to fit 32x32

Meant to be used with Undine boss by Kickchon.

name: smwgraphics-touhou-eiyashou-imperishable-night-stage-6b-outside
title: Touhou Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night - Stage 6B (Outside)
description:
I'm back, and this time with a BG from Touhou of all games. This background was originally 512x512, but I had to reduce it to 256x256 due to many many tiles the BG uses. I followed Thomas' idea of reducing the picture as best I could, until nearly 4 ExGFX are used. The result was really good and you do have room for a FG. This was used in the real final battle with Kaguya Houraisan. Use it in boss battles with no scrolling for both background and foreground or levels with background scrolling set to none.

WARNING! THIS SUBMISSION SACRIFICES ALMOST ALL OF THE FG2 TILES.

name: smwgraphics-touhou-gensoukyou-lotus-land-story-extra-stage
title: Touhou Gensoukyou: Lotus Land Story - Extra Stage
description: The background for the extra stage from Touhou Gensoukyou: Lotus Land Story for the NEC PC-98. Also this game was the source for that Bad Apple!! song you've definitely heard. This BG would be perfect for a dreamlike level or something. Excuse the one lumpy black thing, it's not my fault.

versions.title: Touhou Gensoukyou: Lotus Land Story - Extra Stage

name: smwgraphics-touhou-koumakyou-the-embodiment-of-scarlet-devil-spellcard-remilia-scarlet
title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil - Spellcard (Remilia Scarlet)
description:
Here's the BG from Touhou 6. Sure, it's also seen in Stage 6, but this BG is used as spellcard effect by Remilia Scarlet. This was just as hard as Touhou Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night - Stage 6B (Outside), if not harder. This BG was not only harder to reduce tiles, but I had to remove the 'black' pixels, in order to conserve tile space. This does use the bushes, diagonal pipes and part of the fence tiles. The rest can be used.
No credit required.

versions.title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil - Spellcard (Remilia Scarlet)
versions.filename: Touhou Koumakyou - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil - Spellcard (Remilia Scarlet).zip

title: Touhou Seirensen ~ Undefined Fantastic Object - UFO
description: The UFO from Touhou Seirensen ~ Undefined Fantastic Object, serving as a Torpedo Ted replacement. Palettes for all three colored variations are included.

versions.title: Touhou Seirensen ~ Undefined Fantastic Object - UFO

name: smwgraphics-touhou-yumejikuu-the-phantasmagoria-of-dim-dream-mimi-chan
title: Touhou Yumejikuu ~ The Phantasmagoria of Dim.Dream - Mimi-chan
description:
Mimi-chan, the sentient ICBM, who makes a brief appearance in one of Touhou Yumejikuu ~ The Phantasmagoria of Dim.Dream's endings.
She replaces Torpedo Ted.

versions.title: Touhou Yumejikuu ~ The Phantasmagoria of Dim.Dream - Mimi-chan

name: smwgraphics-tower

description:
I got bored, so I drew a background. Yay!

Contains a palette and a Map16 page.

name: smwgraphics-tower-of-disarray-grassland
title: Tower of Disarray - Grassland
description: A flexible grassland tileset originally created for my hack, Tower of Disarray.  Give credit if you use these.  Also, please change the palette up a bit, don't just use the provided one and call it good.

name: smwgraphics-toxic-swamp-forest
title: Toxic Swamp/Forest
description: For C3 summer 2020, I wanted to make a toxic-swamp-like tileset, but I ended up adding forest setpieces, so I decided to combine the two themes into one. Features both decorative and platform trees, as well as climbable vines, and mushrooms from another recent tileset of mine. The poisonous muck is ExAnimated, and acts like lava by default.

name: smwgraphics-toy-story-snes-a-buzz-clip
title: Toy Story (SNES) - A Buzz Clip
description:
Ripped from A Buzz Clip in the Toy Story's Super NES version.

Update: Turned the latest color of the palette 3 to the color being previously in the back area.

name: smwgraphics-toy-story-snes-andy-s-bedroom
title: Toy Story (SNES) - Andy's Bedroom
description:
This background seen in the first stage of Toy Story for the SNES. The wooden floor is not included due to it making heavy use of parallax scrolling.

Compatible with the Layer 3 background of this very same level .

name: smwgraphics-toy-story-snes-roller-bob-stage
title: Toy Story (SNES) - Roller Bob Stage
description: This background is found in the skate stage from Toy Story (SNES).  It has been slightly modified to fit better in Super Mario World.

name: smwgraphics-toyland
title: Toyland
description: MFG wanted a layer 3 version of the layer 2 toyland BG, so I converted that one to layer 3. You should use either this, this or this patch to prevent cutoffness.

name: smwgraphics-transparent-coin-block
title: Transparent Coin Block
description: a simple coin block or kaizo block, transparent with an animation.

name: smwgraphics-trash-ice-temple-of-death
title: Trash: Ice Temple of Death
description: This is an icy set from my old hack. Since the hack is cancelled now, i'm releasing it.

name: smwgraphics-treasure-hunter-g-aged-cave-ferric-falcon
title: Treasure Hunter G - Aged Cave (Ferric Falcon)
description:
A very detailed background from Treasure Hunter G. It's used in a cutscene at the beginning of the game.

Reripped from scratch, using the original game's tilemap. Best scrolling option for this graphic is Vertical: Costant, Horizontal: None.

Uses the final three colors of palette row 5.

A good fit for unusual levels.

versions.title: Treasure Hunter G - Aged Cave (Ferric Falcon)
versions.filename: Treasure Hunter G - Aged Cave (Ferric Falcon).zip

name: smwgraphics-treasure-hunter-g-ending-cutscene-mountains
title: Treasure Hunter G - Ending Cutscene (Mountains)
description:
The background seen in the ending cutscene of Treasure Hunter G, where the turtle samurai character awaits Red and Green for a duel. Expanded and looped to fit with SMW standards.

A good fit for mountain levels.

name: smwgraphics-tree-hut
title: Tree Hut
description:
Another handmade tileset by me. Give credit if used bleh...

Main tileset replaces palette 2 the trees, palette 4.

name: smwgraphics-trees-and-mountain
title: Trees and Mountain
description:
This is my first release in a very long time.

It is an original BG based on this photograph: http://img2.travelblog.org/Photos/19952/117213/f/800503-Jiji-Mountain-0.jpg

name: smwgraphics-treetops
title: Treetops
description:
A remake of an ancient tileset I never submitted to the graphics section, some treetops. This tileset contains a lot of decoration blocks as well as wider trees you can experiment with if you choose!

Feel free to contact me if you have any suggestions or concerns, and enjoy!

Please give some credit if used!

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-chartmoon-tower-rooftop
title: Trials of Mana - Chartmoon Tower (Rooftop)
description:
The background from the top of Chartmoon Tower, from Trials of Mana / Seiken Densetsu 3. By default, it doesn't loop.

UPDATE: Organized the background better by removing some cutoff. Better slot and palette allocations.

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-clouds
title: Trials of Mana - Clouds
description:
I know Buu already submitted this background, but I made a Lunar Magic 1.7+ compatible version. This one uses BG1 and BG2, and 2 palette rows.
Enjoy~

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-dark-castle-exterior
title: Trials of Mana - Dark Castle (Exterior)
description:
The Dark Castle exterior background from Trials of Mana / Seiken Densetsu 3. A good fit for levels nearby castles, in general. The GFX space is roughly 109 tiles, meaning there's a lot of free space in the BG3 slot.

UPDATE: Better palette row allocation, while keeping fidelity to the source material.

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-dark-lich
title: Trials of Mana - Dark Lich
description: One of three backgounds used for the Dark Lich boss battle, one of three possible final bosses in Seiken Densetsu 3.

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-dragon-emperor
title: Trials of Mana - Dragon Emperor
description:
The background for the Dragon Emperor (one of three final bosses) in Seiken Densetsu 3.

Be warned, it uses four palette rows.

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-dragon-s-hole
title: Trials of Mana - Dragon's Hole
description: Also known as the purple and white cave type background people should know from Brutal Mario.

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-glass-desert
title: Trials of Mana - Glass Desert
description:
The background used for the tiny area outside the Dragon's Hole dungeon.

You may recognize a version of this in Brutal Mario, in the same location.

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-mirage-palace
title: Trials of Mana - Mirage Palace
description: Rip from Seiken Densetsu 3

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-mirage-palace-hallways
title: Trials of Mana - Mirage Palace (Hallways)
description:
Two Mirage Palace foregrounds. The map16 is a bit of a mess, but thankfully I included two sample levels taken from a hack I was making to show you how to assemble the foregrounds.

Works great with carol's moving clouds background, or anything else that works in a half 3D view.

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-ocean
title: Trials of Mana - Ocean
description:
You might recognise this from the area before the dragon boss in Brutal Mario, it's an ocean graphics set.

Simple, compared to most Seiken Densetsu 3 graphics too.

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-path-to-heaven
title: Trials of Mana - Path To Heaven
description:
A beautiful and huge rip of this background from Seiken Densetsu 3. It uses 3 palettes and 3 ExGFX files (only compatible with LM 1.7x).
Enjoy, and credit is not needed.

versions.title: Trials of Mana - Path To Heaven

name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-woods-of-wandara-boss
title: Trials of Mana - Woods of Wandara (Boss)
description:
A pretty detailed background from Trials of Mana previously known as Seiken Densetsu 3.

It's the area where the player fights Mispolm, the Benevodon of the Woods.

This update includes bigger optimizations, saving a lot of space, now it doesn't use the FG2 slot, and most of BG3 space is free for more graphics. Accuracy to the source material also has been improved. Map 16 and palette are significantly better, too.

A good fit for cutscenes, one screen forest rooms or whatever you wish to use it. Please remember that background scrolling should be: None, None.

Originally used in Gacha Trouble, my Questionable Level Design Contest entry.

versions.title: Trials of Mana - Woods of Wandara (Boss)
versions.filename: Trials of Mana - Woods of Wandara (Boss Area).zip

name: smwgraphics-trip-world-yakopoo
title: Trip World - Yakopoo
description: A cute bunny-like creature called Yakopoo,  main character from Trip World for the Game Boy, as a reskin to the goomba / galoomba sprite.  A good fit for natural areas, in general.

name: smwgraphics-tsukikomori-title-screen
title: Tsukikomori - Title Screen
description: The title screen to obscure SNES visual novel, Tsukikomori. Uses BG2, BG3, and all of Palette 3.

name: smwgraphics-tsunami
title: Tsunami
description:
This is a pack of Graphics made by pixel artists for my abandoned project. They are pretty good quality, hope someone will use them :)
There is a overworld, a small amount of overworld graphics, and 4-5 tilesets with alternative palettes.

Use anything you want!
Modify & repack if you want!

name: smwgraphics-tulip-plant
title: Tulip Plant
description: A tulip variant of Piranha Plants, from my hack Spesh Planet. No custom palettes are included.

name: smwgraphics-turn-block-emoticons

The SMW Central's emoticons with turn block design, now ripped for in-game use.

Uses BG3 and palette 6, with mostly yellow original palette and 3 custom colors.

Created by wye for site and ripped by Hammerer for SMW.

name: smwgraphics-turok-evolution-gba-battlefields-forest
title: Turok Evolution (GBA) - Battlefields (Forest)
description:
The Jungle Area from the Turok Evolution GBA Game. What do you think about this?

Uses the second half of palette 4.

Happy New Year (2025)

name: smwgraphics-turok-evolution-gba-final-frontier-flesh
title: Turok Evolution (GBA) - Final Frontier (Flesh)
description:
C3 WINTER 2025:

The "flesh" area from Turok: Evolution Game Boy Advance game.
It includes 2 colored variants: Brown and Red.
What do you think about these?

name: smwgraphics-twinbee-rainbow-bell-adventures-ice
title: Twinbee Rainbow Bell Adventures - Ice
description:
You may recognise this from the Santa Claus level in Brutal Mario, but this is a far easier to use version.

Uses one ExGFX file and palette rows 3 and 7.

name: smwgraphics-twisted-castle-and-switch-palace
title: Twisted Castle and Switch Palace
description: One of the most colorful graphics with realistic for twisted castle and switch palace.

name: smwgraphics-twitch-smiley-emote
title: Twitch Smiley Emote

The Twitch smiley face that appears in chat when you type :)

Requested by Le4che for a title screen background. Useful for trolls or jokes.

name: smwgraphics-u-four-ia-the-saga-font
title: U-four-ia: The Saga - Font
description:
The font used in U-four-ia: The Saga, originally released in Japan as Hebereke.

Warning: This font has only uppercase!
Also, the # and the parenthesis are custom, the font originally didn't have them.

Update: Fixed the ' character, I forgot to move it up in YY-CHR and I didn't notice it at first!

name: smwgraphics-ueki-no-housoku-jingi-sakuretsu-nouryokusha-battle-inuyama-park-robert-stage
title: Ueki no Housoku: Jingi Sakuretsu! Nouryokusha Battle -  Inuyama Park (Robert Stage 1)
description:
I sure love converting BGs from games I've never heard of. This is the japanese version of Ueki no Housoku Jingi Sakuretsu! Nouryokusha Battle for the Game Boy Advance. Originally, this was ripped by OmniGamerX. I converted his rip for SMW usage. I had to remove one column of 8x8 tiles since I had no idea if it had any use. Overwrites bushes, diagonal pipes and 1 color gradient.
You should use either a patch that allows horizontal scroll speeds towards slow or set the Horizontal BG scrolling to None.
OmniGamerX needs credit.

versions.title: Ueki no Housoku: Jingi Sakuretsu! Nouryokusha Battle -  Inuyama Park (Robert Stage 1)
versions.filename: Ueki no Housoku Jingi Sakuretsu%21 Nouryokusha Battle - Inuyama Park (Robert Stage 1).zip

Ripped from the SNES version

This uses palette 3, 5 and 7

A cave tile set I made and released on C3; it includes a Foreground, a Background, and a Layer 3.

mod note: as the original status bar will be moved behind the foreground (see: screenshot 1) you may want to use a status bar patch (e.g. Sprite Status Bar)

A custom underground foreground made by Mr. Boo. Give credit to him!

Have fun! ;)

I realized that the only font that had to Undertale was only cutscenes , so I decided to try to recreate the font for smw.
Credits to Toby Fox for this pretty game.
If you want to credit me feel free.

name: smwgraphics-undertale-snowdin-forest
title: Undertale - Snowdin Forest
description:
The tall trees from the forest area of Snowdin, the area where you first meet Sans and Papyrus. The Layer 3 trees are meant to be used with Layer 3 priority enabled. The background colour in the screenshots of the Layer 3 trees has been changed so the trees are easier to see.

Mod Edit: if you would like to use the Layer 3 trees, it is recommended that you apply a patch such as Minimalist Status Bars or Sprite Status Bar to avoid cutoff.

name: smwgraphics-undertale-styled-outlined-font
title: Undertale Styled Outlined Font
description: An in-level font styled after the in-game sans-serif text of Undertale that has an outline for legibility. Uses vanilla palettes.

name: smwgraphics-underwater
title: Underwater
description: Here's an SMB3-inspired water background with translucent Layer 3 water. If you use the water, you will need to install an alternate HUD patch.

name: smwgraphics-uniracers-downer
title: Uniracers - Downer
description: A pretty looking background form Uniracers that could fit a variety of settings. Do keep in mind that while this background doesn't use too much palette or graphics space it takes up three map16 pages.

Have you ever seen those big tree's from "Forest of Illusion" and thinked that it looked like an OwO face?, well, probably you didn't, but whatever...

This simple modification makes the big tree have an "UwU" face instead of an "OwO" one, good for meme hacks or a cute/pink overworld style's.

Background used in the Pai's stage in the bootleg game V.R Fighter VS Taken2.

This is a VERY HUGE background: only FG3 is free to use. Keep this in mind.

versions.title: V.R Fighter VS Taken2 - Pai's Stage

name: smwgraphics-valis-the-fantasm-soldier-yuko-asou
title: Valis: The Fantasm Soldier - Yuko Asou
description:
Submitted during Winter C3 2023!

Yuko Asou, the heroine from the well-known Valis video game series, arrives to Super Mario World—and she's ready to face off against the forces of darkness! This fully-featured player set includes all poses for each powerup state, as well as cutscenes and the overworld. Uses only vanilla Mario (and Luigi) palettes, so no need to install custom global palettes when using!

Made by ValisEmma of The Spriters Resource and ported by yours truly for ROM hacking use.

versions.title: Valis: The Fantasm Soldier - Yuko Asou

name: smwgraphics-vanilla-cutscene
title: Vanilla cutscene
description:
For those who always wanted to make a vanilla cutscene without Romi's Cutscene Tool, here is your present.
Features uppercase letters, lowercase ones, punctuation, numbers from 0 to 9, and an "up" arrow.

This took me more than 10 hours to "make", transfer and reorganize, so could you give credit please ?

name: smwgraphics-vanilla-grass-remastered
title: Vanilla Grass Remastered
description: Remastered SMW graphics. Uses a custom palette, yet are compatible with original game map16.

name: smwgraphics-vanilla-ish-castle-interior
title: Vanilla-Ish Castle Interior
description:
I call this "Vanilla-ish" because it uses vanilla graphics, but isn't based on an existing vanilla background. In addition, many of the graphics needed to be edited in the transition from 4bpp to 2bpp.

You'll need an alternate status bar for this to work properly.

name: smwgraphics-vanilla-styled-beach-expansion
title: Vanilla Styled Beach Expansion
description: This is an expansion of GFX1A that can be used for beach levels.

name: smwgraphics-vanilla-styled-castle-expansion
title: Vanilla Styled Castle Expansion
description: Here's an expansion for the vanilla castle set.

name: smwgraphics-vanilla-styled-title-screen-font
title: Vanilla Styled Title Screen Font
description:
This is a title screen font drawn in a style similar to that of the vanilla title screen.
I made it to be more consistent with things like size and thickness, since this always bothered me a bit in the vanilla title screen.

This set contains all letters from A-Z, as well as numbers 0-9 and a few commonly used symbols.

Check the included Read Me if you need help on how to use it.

Credits aren't mandatory, but would be highly appreciated! =D

name: smwgraphics-vanilla-styled-underwater-expansion
title: Vanilla Styled Underwater Expansion
description: Here's an addendum to GFX1A for water levels.  It even includes Jalectros that can be turned into coins with a Silver P-Switch.

name: smwgraphics-vanilla-title-screen-logo-letters-numbers
title: Vanilla Title Screen Logo Letters & Numbers
description:
Every letter of the alphabet and the numbers 0-9 in the style of the vanilla SMW Title Screen Logo. I made this because many people asked me if I could do the title screen for them, so this should be easy to use for everyone. Of course you still need to combine the letters to the word you need. Also, so many people helped me with my hacks that I decided to give something back to the community to help other people!

Check the readme for more information.

Credit is appreciated because this took VERY long to make,
but not necessary.

versions.title: Vanilla Title Screen Logo Letters & Numbers

Credit would be appreciated.

Contains:

- Bullet Bill (horizontal, vertical, and diagonal), Banzai Bill, Torpedo Ted
- Cheep Cheep (from SMB1)
- Piranha Plant, Muncher
- Big Boo, Boo (from YI), Boo Buddies, Boo Block

- Lakitu, Fuzzy
